nodeData.topic: Day 01 · Nothing is a 'Tall Order' for a Bona Fide Disciple
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.21 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj opens the series with the verse on approaching a spiritual master: the disciple should come having finished with material ambitions, and the guru must be learned, realised and detached. When both are bona fide, no instruction feels like a 'tall order'. He also asks whether the soul has a name, and shows that material rewards are really another form of punishment. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse names who should approach a spiritual master and the qualities of the guru to be approached. It is spoken by the Nava-yogendras in answer to King Nimi.

Maharaj notes that Srila Prabhupada quoted this verse very often because it is so important; that morning he had been listening to one of Prabhupada's lectures on it.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:20 (auto-transcript): “This is one of the verses that Prabhupada quoted most of the times in this lecture, because it is very, very important. And I was listening to one of the lectures he gave on this verse this morning. I was listening to that. So Srila Prabhupada started the lecture by saying…”

Prabhupada began that lecture by saying the purpose of Vedic civilisation is to go back to Godhead. In this world, to learn a subject you approach a professional who knows it; spiritual life is the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:15 (auto-transcript): “And he gave an example. In this material world, if one wants to know about something, you have to go to the professional who knows that Soviet matter. have to approach and there are two two two things in this material world which we can see very clearly one is prayer another…”

children.topic: Come when finished with sense gratification
children.note:
The word 'therefore' in the verse points to a disciple who is tired of pleasure here and even in the heavenly planets. Only then does one go to the guru — that was the standard.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:50 (auto-transcript): “Here, Tasman Guru Mpapa Deheta, when one has finished with material activities, Tasman, when one has finished with all material activities, one is tired of sense gratification in this material world, sense gratification in the heavenly event to Pramaloka, when one is finished…”

Maharaj says most of us try to do two things at once: still interested in sense gratification while following a process that asks us to give it up. Even the renounced find the path difficult; for those carrying both it is most difficult — and we experience that every day. — “It will be most difficult.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:30 (auto-transcript): “that was the standard that was a process it was easy because if we are trying to do two things at the same time it's very difficult to get the ultimate results why because attention will be divided so when one is beginning spiritual life when a beginning spiritual life or…”

Today we come to the guru with material desires and problems. The verse makes clear that solving these is not the guru's business; the ultimate goal lies outside this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:15 (auto-transcript): “now we go to guru with material desires material problems this verse is pointing it out very clearly that is not guru's business what is guru's business is mentioned here a guru has the qualification just like the disciples have qualification the guru also has qualification…”

children.topic: Guru and disciple both bona fide
children.note:
As the disciple has qualifications, so does the guru. If both are not bona fide, each ends up angry because their desires are not fulfilled; if both are, things go smoothly.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:41 (auto-transcript): “mentioned here a guru has the qualification just like the disciples have qualification the guru also has qualification both must be bona fide if both are not bona fide it will be difficult to make progress we will end up being angry with each other because my desire is not…”

children.topic: Easy for Rupa, Sanatana and Pariksit
children.note:
It was not difficult for Caitanya Mahaprabhu to give his message, nor for Rupa and Sanatana Gosvami to accept and execute it. The same with Sukadeva Gosvami and Maharaja Pariksit, who came for the ultimate goal, not for material blessings.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:25 (auto-transcript): “we have seen that example when Rupa Goswami, Sanatana Goswami, met Chetan Mahaprabhu. It was not difficult for Chetan Mahaprabhu to deliver his message. It was not difficult. He delivered the message and it was not difficult for the student, Rupa Sanatana Goswami, to accept…”

children.topic: No such thing as a 'tall order'
children.note:
Devotees today say 'Guru has given me a tall order.' Maharaj explains it really means: I am not ready for the guru, so the order is taller than me.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:25 (auto-transcript): “oh, these days they have a language, guru has given me a tall order, what is tall order. Tall order means what? I am not ready for the guru but I have come to meet him. Therefore the order given is taller than me. I will not be able to carry it up because he is taller than…”

Bona fide disciples never used this language. For a disciple whose desire for material pleasure is not finished, every order becomes tall and devotional service becomes a big struggle.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:50 (auto-transcript): “There is nothing like a tall order for bona fide disciple like Parishit Maharaj Adjuna Rupa Sanateng Goswami. They don't have this language tall order. This is a tall order for me because i'm not qualified yet therefore the order and the guru has to deliver the message as it…”

children.topic: Carrying the order on one's head
children.note:
Maharaj cites Prthu Maharaja carrying the order on his head — executing it without complaint — and Pariksit welcoming Sukadeva's words with joy. When guru and disciple are both perfect, a miracle takes place.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:00 (auto-transcript): “the order which was given Pritho Maharaj carried it on the head he didn't show this is too heavy for me it is not a tall order he carried it on his head means he executed it no complaint that is the situation when sugar was speaking my president oh this this is difficult how…”

The Gita says the devotee is resolute; the irresolute are pulled in all directions. Maharaj points to the camera filming the class: when it is focused, the object is clear. Without focus in Krishna consciousness, distraction comes in many ways.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:33 (auto-transcript): “bargeta christian carefully mentioned that a devotee is what resolute in determination the goal is clear for those who are irresolute what happened a lot of distractions distraction from all direction destruction means there is no focus that is destruction no focus when there…”

The verse also describes the guru: expert in the Vedas, realised in the Supreme, and detached from material affairs.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:44 (auto-transcript): “approach the special master and the vision is also given here very clearly sabde parecha nishnatham it is translated here the vedas the vedas the spiritual master must have a perfect knowledge about the vedas and the supreme presidency of godhead then he will be able to…”

With perfect knowledge the guru can give it to the disciple. If he cannot destroy the disciple's ignorance, the disciple will be unhappy and start looking for something else.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:22 (auto-transcript): “about the vedas and the supreme presidency of godhead then he will be able to distribute that to the disciple if he's not able to destroy the ignorance of the disciple they will not be happy and they will start looking for something else so so many of our chariots have been…”

Maharaj repeats Prabhupada's simple example from the lecture: if a finger is cut off, I still exist. So I am not the body, I own it — this understanding should be realised by a spiritual master.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:57 (auto-transcript): “the body but consciousness and properly gave example in the lecture he was giving this one he gave example i am not the body who can easily understand the proper example how am i not this body if if if one of the finger is cut off i continue to exist right one finger is off…”

Citing the Bhagavatam, Maharaj says no one should dare sit on the vyasasana unless free from illicit sex, gambling, intoxication and meat eating, because sitting there means representing Srila Prabhupada.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:36 (auto-transcript): “that should be realized by a spiritual master then bhagavatam 116 116 proper said then no no one should dare not sit on the yasa sand if he is not free from the four vices one should not sit here if one is not free from four vices what are the four vices no lysis sex no…”

A representative does not change the original speaker's meaning. Simply repeating the purport shows no understanding; speaking as it is means explaining in a way that corresponds to the original. Without explanation one is like a robot, which has no soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:23 (auto-transcript): “import of the original speaker a representative is one who will present it exactly as it is the word as it is has different meanings different meaning as it is different meanings as it is we the the this this verse has a purport right so as it is means what if you are…”

children.topic: Does the soul have a name?
children.note:
A devotee asked Maharaj this the day before, and he brings it to the room 'to get the answer from the scholars' — some say yes, some say no.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:48 (auto-transcript): “he must ultimately have an original status on a higher platform yesterday what they asked me what he asked me does the soul has a name i'm looking for the answer so i'm asking you the soul does she have a name huh i got a question yesterday today i came so i can ask and get…”

If he asks someone to carry 'this thing' without naming it, what will they take? Nothing. A book stand, a table, a carafe all have names. If temporary objects have names, why would the eternal soul have none?

🎙 Maharaj at 44:15 (auto-transcript): “if i say please take this thing to that place what is that thing what is that thing no i'm saying just take this thing to that place but what is it what is it i'm telling you to take there no name no name so what will you take what will you take nothing right if i see take…”

In the spiritual world there is no material body, yet there are Subala, Arjuna, Madhumangala, Lalita, Yasoda. Nothing is nameless there; the body has a name and the soul also has a name.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:03 (auto-transcript): “In the spiritual world, we don't have Subal, we don't have Arjuna, Madhu Mangala, Lalita Saki, we don't have, what is that? It's a soul. In the spiritual world, there is no material body. No material is there. It's all spiritual. So if you are Lalita, that's what? You have no…”

This is why the question matters: the guru's work is to remove ignorance and establish knowledge. One who cannot do so is not bona fide and should not be listened to. — “guru's business to destroy ignorance and establish knowledge”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:00 (auto-transcript): “word say so so it's as a name the soul has a name is it clear yes this should be understood this is guru's business to destroy ignorance and establish knowledge if he's not qualified to destroy ignorance he is not bona fide and should not be listened to so the verse here…”

The purport says material happiness is another kind of punishment. Maharaj makes it concrete with everyday examples.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:25 (auto-transcript): “is it not true for for example you have we have been you win a lottery right win a lottery Now you have big money. Is it the blessing or punishment? Eh? But, but, every activity we will do for this money, we are going to pay for it. True or not? We will pay for it. And, when…”

With little money we commit small sins; with big money, big sins — and we pay for every act. So is the windfall a blessing or a punishment? — “So is that a blessing for us to expand our sinful life?”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:25 (auto-transcript): “is it not true for for example you have we have been you win a lottery right win a lottery Now you have big money. Is it the blessing or punishment? Eh? But, but, every activity we will do for this money, we are going to pay for it. True or not? We will pay for it. And, when…”

When fame grows, enemies grow. Those around the throne are thinking how to get there themselves. It is very rare to be appreciated in this world — even Krishna was loved by few. — “When your fame expanded, your enemies have also expanded.”

🎙 Maharaj at 49:29 (auto-transcript): “Materially, you may say, okay, it's a reward. So my fame has expanded. When your fame expanded, your enemies have also expanded. Your enemies have increased. Is it true? You're sitting on the throne. People are sitting there and they look near you. What are they thinking?…”

In Mauritius devotees campaigned against a McDonald's opening right beside the Phoenix temple, and lost. On Christmas Day the restaurant's compound and both streets were full, while the temple had five cars — so who has more disciples?

🎙 Maharaj at 50:50 (auto-transcript): “so it's always more popular not sure some years ago in mauritius some years ago in mauritius the phoenix temple and the phoenix temple in mauritius just beside it just beside it is mcdonald mcdonald restaurant remember they were heavy campaign they were campaigning socially…”

children.topic: A crown that pushes one down
children.note:
Citing Sukadeva Gosvami in the second canto, Maharaj says that for a non-devotee every material facility leads downward. Only for a devotee like Prabhupada is it a reward, because everything is used in Krishna's service — that is the security.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:22 (auto-transcript): “confined by Sukhadev Goswami second canto if one is not a devotee the crown you have on your head is what the lord to push one down to hell Sukhadev Goswami second canto only if one is a devotee like Prabhupada then our world is a reward why because everything is used in…”

children.topic: A prison is still a prison
children.note:
Whatever position one holds in prison — even president or prime minister — the place is still a prison. Higher and lower material positions cannot remove that.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:41 (auto-transcript): “but any position in prison is ultimately punishment if you are if you're a president or prime minister in the prison what is the difference the name is prison once i level is a prison whatever position we have cannot it cannot remove it you cannot remove that that tent is…”

Maharaj recalls an episode from the day before: Caitanya Mahaprabhu teased a poor devotee — you chant every day but look at your house and clothes, why not worship Durga? The devotee replied: am I naked, am I starving? I eat sanctified food and stay out of hospital; please let me chant. That is the consciousness of a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:39 (auto-transcript): “material existence. Yesterday we mentioned it. Sri Satham Mahapurou, he came to and he was teaching him, not teaching him, he was using us to teach us the consciousness that this devotees will have. So Sri Satham Mahapurou said, hey, just look, we are chanting Hare Krishna,…”

In this world every opulence has another side that becomes punishment, as examples of fall through wealth and beauty show. In Vaikuntha all six opulences are desirable, complete and eternal — and the bona fide guru knows this from scripture, not imagination.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:26 (auto-transcript): “the opulences of christ are not desirable is it not what happened to the money before it became that of the money what happened to him yeah he fell down from beauty vijadara what happened to vijadara beauty right beauty from beauty he had a problem so our facilities who have…”

Four questions from the devotees at the end of class.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:48 (auto-transcript): “Any comments or questions? Yes, Prabhu. Hare Krishna, Drana Maharaj Ji. Thank you Maharaj Ji for a wonderful lecture. Maharaj Ji, my question is that as you explained that we have to give up our material activities then we can start spiritual life. They cannot go together.…”

If we indulge in small material things like prajalpa but our chanting, hearing and reading continue, how do we see that it still affects us?

🎙 Maharaj at 59:11 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Drana Maharaj Ji. Thank you Maharaj Ji for a wonderful lecture. Maharaj Ji, my question is that as you explained that we have to give up our material activities then we can start spiritual life. They cannot go together. While practicing spiritual life If we did…”

Be grateful to the acaryas who know our condition and brought us here. Keep the goal in view, add Krishna consciousness to your present condition and train the mind step by step. — “I can gradually, gradually, gradually raise my standard to that platform.”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:54 (auto-transcript): “We should be grateful to our Acharya, we should be grateful to them in so many ways. One of them is that they know our condition and they have brought us here. Now that we are here, we should be conscious that, okay, this is the goal, I have to work towards it, what my…”

children.topic: Q2 · Sastra for the soul's name?
children.note:
If someone asks for sastra to back up the point that the soul has a name, how should we reply?

🎙 Maharaj at 61:08 (auto-transcript): “When you asked the question if the soul has a name, so we got into the conclusion that by your explanation that the soul has a name. So since we have to quote Guru, Shadhu, Shastra, so you are the Shadhu and the Guru. So if someone asks me, can you back it up with Shastra,…”

Vasudeva, Balarama, Yasoda, Pradyumna, Aniruddha, Sankarsana — everyone in the spiritual world is named. A devotee adds that our name waits to be revealed; Maharaj agrees, recalling Lokanatha Gosvami telling Narottama dasa Thakura his eternal name.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:40 (auto-transcript): “My name? I didn't create them now from here, from here. All the personalities in the spiritual where they have name, by contrast, all they have name. All the visual, all the special visual, they are all named. They're all named. Pradumna, Aniruddha, Bhashadeva, Sankar Sen,…”

We know the goal, but our conditioning makes us do unfavourable things. Since every act has a result, what is the result of these?

🎙 Maharaj at 63:02 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj you mentioned that how for every action and we know this also but you reminded us that there is definitely a result yes so Maharaj related slightly to the first question that was asked by that Prabhuji it relates a little bit that while we are on that path our goal is…”
Referring to the Gita 10.10 purport: knowing Krishna is the goal but acting fruitively is karma-yoga, speculatively is jnana-yoga, with love is bhakti-yoga. We do all three in a day.

Krishna knows a mistake is a mistake, and the reaction is small, for purification. Deliberate sin brings heavy reactions. Repentance burns karma: if we don't justify our weakness, feel bad and pray constantly, we will succeed. — “If you do sinful activities deliberately, you have heavy consequences for it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 65:17 (auto-transcript): “There are two things. If we are doing something by mistake, Krishna understands. It's a mistake. Krishna knows that this is a mistake. We will not get so much punishment for it, to be small. To be small. Yes. For purification. If you do sinful activities deliberately, you…”

children.topic: Q4 · Is our initiated name eternal?
children.note:
Is the name given by the spiritual master our eternal name? Maharaj answers that Prabhupada says remembering that name at death delivers us — it is spiritual and powerful.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:09 (auto-transcript): “Thank you, Maharaj. Is it a correct understanding then when we say that the name given to us by our spiritual master is our eternal name? I remember, it's the proper mention, it's the proper mention that if we remember our name at the time of death, we'll be delivered. If you…”

nodeData.topic: Day 02 · Let Your Guru Make You a Pure Devotee
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.22 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Accepting a spiritual master is compulsory, and he is to be approached as a worshipable deity, served without duplicity and only for his pleasure. Maharaj shows how a guru deals differently with sincere and deceitful disciples, why a guru connected to the parampara is never alone, and, through Bali Maharaja, how Krishna gives himself to one who surrenders. Our only obstacles are crookedness and faithlessness. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse is about learning devotional service from a spiritual master accepted as one's very life, so that the Lord, satisfied, gives himself to the disciple.

children.topic: Scripture is plain; we complicate it
children.note:
Maharaj begins: everything in the scripture is very plain. Things only become complicated through our own crookedness, not because of the scripture.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:44 (auto-transcript): “The scripture, everything is very plain. Everything becomes complicated with our own crookedness, not with the scripture. If you look very carefully, this verse, we have been given a direction, a direction to follow, to accept a bona fide spiritual master. It is compulsory.…”

The verse gives a direction: accept a bona fide spiritual master. Just as a child needs parents to grow and we must eat to live, a guru is compulsory. — “It is compulsory. It is not optional.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:07 (auto-transcript): “If you look very carefully, this verse, we have been given a direction, a direction to follow, to accept a bona fide spiritual master. It is compulsory. It is not optional. It is compulsory. Just like it is compulsory for a child to help the parent to grow. Or it is…”

children.topic: Approach him as a worshipable deity
children.note:
What attitude should we bring? The verse says to see the spiritual master as a worshipable deity — and deities are not idols, they are the Lord himself.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:11 (auto-transcript): “So we should approach a bona fide spiritual master as what? What should be our attitude? What should be in the mind that we are making the approach? It is clearly mentioned here. we should see the spiritual master as worshipable deity. Worshipable deity. Deities are not…”

A journalist told Srila Prabhupada his followers seemed to worship him. Prabhupada said yes, he had to train them that way, because where there is reservation the mercy does not flow; it flows only where there is transparency.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:55 (auto-transcript): “A journalist has brought up. Swamiji, it seems that your followers are particularly worshipping you. Papa said, yes. I have to train them like that. Because if there is a reservation, the mercy will not flow. The mercy will flow only if there is no reservation. There is…”

So we approach the guru as worshipable and our attitude toward him must be free of duplicity — the key word of the verse.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:31 (auto-transcript): “So it is mentioned here that we should approach the special master as a worshippable deity and our attitude towards him should be without duplicity. Bishwana Chagrebachete Kora mentioned two classes of disciples, Niskapot, Bokta, and Sarkapot. His Holiness Golgobina Maharaj…”

Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura speaks of two classes of disciple — the sincere (niskapata) and the duplicitous (sakapata) — a point Maharaj heard explained in detail by Gour Govinda Maharaj.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:45 (auto-transcript): “Bishwana Chagrebachete Kora mentioned two classes of disciples, Niskapot, Bokta, and Sarkapot. His Holiness Golgobina Maharaj spoke details on this. Niskapot and Sarkapot. Sarkapot Bokta is a duplicious disciple. It's a cheater. Golgobina Maharaj said the guru will cheat him…”

The guru 'cheats' the deceitful disciple by giving position, fame, facilities and followers — but no bhakti. — “You'll be popular, you'll be famous, you have position, you have money, but no bhakti.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:13 (auto-transcript): “Golgobina Maharaj said the guru will cheat him or her. How will the guru do that? A guru will cheat the deceitful disciple by giving him or her positions, fame, prestigious life, facilities for sanctification, no bhakti. You'll get fame. People will worship you everywhere you…”

Everyone knew Duryodhana as Balarama's best disciple. Balarama travelled with him, trained him daily and even sided with him over Krishna — yet all along he was preparing him to be killed by Bhima, which happened in Balarama's own presence. Duryodhana thought he was fooling the Lord; the Lord was cheating him.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:00 (auto-transcript): “We have seen that between Lord Balaram and De Rodan. The whole world knows that De Rodan is the best disciple of Balaranji. And if you see the relationship between Balaram and De Rodan, And Balaram tried externally to make sure he proved to Durotan that he is his best…”

children.topic: A sword sharp on both sides
children.note:
The sadhu is like a two-edged blade. The deceitful disciple may get position; the sincere one may often get no position at all, but the guru gives him Krishna-prema. Each receives according to how he relates to the guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:59 (auto-transcript): “so I go with number one I said is sadhu is like a soul both side is very sharp this up is sharp as I'm a shot like like we call our Jonah Sadiya Saty Sadiya Saty means that you can shoot like this you can also shoot this way any direction you can shoot a period which is sad…”

Foolish disciples judge by who is always beside the guru and receives the most attention. Are you sure that is the real favour?

🎙 Maharaj at 28:02 (auto-transcript): “experience, foolish disciples thinking, are you sure? Are you sure? See, he's giving him so many things. He's always with him. He's moving with him. He's doing so many things for him. But are you sure that the Guru does him like that? Are you sure? How many times Sr.…”

Srila Prabhupada met Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati only a few times and never lived with him, while others lived with him all their lives. When the time came he did his guru's work perfectly, and Krishna arranged that godbrothers did not come to help, so the whole credit was his.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:40 (auto-transcript): “How many times Sr. Prabhupada associated with his guru. How many times? Very rare. Very rare. But this is what it is. It has disciples who live with him for the whole life. Sanyansis. They live with him for the whole life. Prophet never lived with his other satswati. Nadia…”

Maharaj's own guru also did not live with Prabhupada and met him only a handful of times — yet Prabhupada put his hand on his head and said his life was a success. We should not be blindfolded; see what is really happening.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:06 (auto-transcript): “it's krishna who made it like that so they will be cheated for being not a bona fide representative my special master is also who was not staying with his proper parents he had never been the proper sarabhad neither was he staying with him not less than 12 times he met not…”

When the disciple serves from the heart with one motive — to please the guru — Krishna gives himself. Maharaj recalls Brahma, begging forgiveness, opening his prayers with 'I offer these to please you.'

🎙 Maharaj at 31:16 (auto-transcript): “when a disciple serve the spiritual master without duplicity completely from the heart the motivation is i want to please the spiritual master with my service when that becomes the motivation that is what the brahma said when the brahma was begging christian for forgiveness…”

children.topic: Will the guru take me home?
children.note:
People ask whether a guru can really take them back to Godhead. The question is unnecessary: the verse already says he will, if we serve without duplicity.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:01 (auto-transcript): “and the intent becomes one the result is krishna will give himself many people are asking will a guru takes you to godhead will a guru take you to godhead this question is not does not need there's no need for this question the guru will take you to godhead are you sure your…”

To say Srila Prabhupada did not make even one pure devotee before he left is to say he was not perfect. Maharaj calls it blasphemy and asks us to stop.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:45 (auto-transcript): “are actually insulting our part when you when you tell me that proper did not make one qualified he devoted before he left, what are you telling me? When you are telling me that Prabhupada did not make one pure devotee before he left here, what are you telling me? He is not…”

A tiny jiva is sent from Vaikuntha to represent Krishna here — is he alone? He carries Krishna's empowerment, and all the devotees who sent him monitor him.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:30 (auto-transcript): “a guru is only one person guru is only one person Sarataka Swami mentioned in but from they will make a regimen like by Kunta and you go down and represent us he's a tiny soul he's a tiny jiva but he has the power to come here and represent Krishna is he alone Is he tiny?…”

children.topic: A branch of the head office
children.note:
Even a company supports the branch it opens. Is the guru not connected to Prabhupada and the parampara? Of course he is — so what is the difficulty?

🎙 Maharaj at 34:21 (auto-transcript): “Even here in the material world, this is done. Do you know? If you open a branch of your company somewhere, you don't support that branch? Right? Is the branch not connected? It's not connected with the head office? So the Guru is not connected with Parampara. The Guru is…”

We don't really believe or trust Prabhupada, yet we keep talking — simply spreading ignorance and frustration. — “The difficulty is our crookedness, our faithlessness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:54 (auto-transcript): “The difficulty is our crookedness, our faithlessness. We don't even believe Prabhupada. We don't believe him. We don't trust him. We don't have faith. But we are speaking. What are we speaking? When we don't believe, we don't have faith. What are we talking? We are simply…”

Is the Hare Krishna mantra from your guru or from Krishna? From Krishna. Chanting sincerely, we connect with countless pure souls responsible for our success; only by disconnecting ourselves are we alone, and alone we cannot advance.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:20 (auto-transcript): “When a devotee is serving with that duplicity, we are chanting Harakasya Mantra. Is Harakasya Mantra from Krishna or is it from only your guru? Harakasya Mantra. Is it from your guru or from Krishna? Krishna. So Krishna gave us, so you are chanting with sincerity. We are not…”

children.topic: The guru gives eyes to see Krishna
children.note:
In the purport Rupa Gosvami's first principles are all about the guru. Maharaj adds his favourite companion verse.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:28 (auto-transcript): “In the pop art here, you see Rupa Goswami is quoted. Where, after the 64th principle, the fight is about what? Guru, guru, guru, guru, guru. So, after the beginning, it's only guru. Because why? Why guru? He is one. He is what? in the December 11th Kanto chapter 26 text 34…”

In SB 11.26.34 the Lord says his devotees give divine sight, while the sun gives only external sight, and only while it is up. The guru gives an eye that sees Krishna at all times — so who is more useful?

children.topic: Don't take a guru for fashion
children.note:
If you doubt your guru you have disconnected yourself. Don't go to someone you don't trust. Prabhupada warned against taking a guru as a fashion; the question is not only whether he is qualified, but whether we are.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:12 (auto-transcript): “difficult something simple what would make it difficult if you doubt your guru you have disconnected yourself completely you have disconnected yourself if you have no faith you have disconnected yourself so if we if you love ourselves and we want to make advancement guru is…”

The purport gives Bali Maharaja as the example of the Lord giving himself to a pure devotee. Maharaj retells it with relish.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:01 (auto-transcript): “So we have a very long purpose also here. I couldn't do Srila Sri Dada Swami. The Lord's tendency to give himself to his pure devotee is demonstrated in the case of Bali Maharaj, who sacrificed his universal kingdom the pleasure of lord vermandev vermandev he came to valimara…”

children.topic: The Lord came as a beggar
children.note:
Vamanadeva came in disguise as a beggar asking for three steps of land. Bali, straightforward and without duplicity, urged him to ask for more; the boy said one not satisfied with a little is never satisfied with millions.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:19 (auto-transcript): “the pleasure of lord vermandev vermandev he came to valimara very intelligent valimara very intelligent a disciple the disciple is not duplicitous valimara proved that quality that you're not duplicitous the woman came with duplicity but the devotee was not duplicitous he won…”

Bali's guru warned that the boy was Vishnu and he would lose everything. Bali reasoned that death would take everything anyway without blessing him, so better to give to Vishnu — and he gave despite the curse.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:07 (auto-transcript): “with one will not be satisfied with millions i want only one okay the gurus no don't give him this boy is not vishnu don't give him if you keep him you lose everything if i give to vision i will lose everything but even if i don't give him that i'm going to lose everything so…”

When the Lord had taken all three worlds, Bali said: everything you took was yours; only my self is mine, so take that. The Lord placed his foot on his head and bound him — and, pleased by his surrender, became his doorkeeper to this day.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:09 (auto-transcript): “comfort about that so even when the lord tried to cheat him bali mara said you have taken everything which belongs to you all that you have taken belongs to you so the only thing you have not taken is what belongs to me my head my life i should give my life to you that is…”

What Maharaj likes most: when the Lord's own city was attacked and he was called to protect it, he said to ask Bali first, and when Bali declined, he did not go. Can Krishna do that for all of us? Yes — only our duplicity and faithlessness stop it.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:22 (auto-transcript): “that is not all that is not this is not what i like most in this case what i like most is different as lord vishnu is is guiding him in dvarka a demon came to attack them another money suggested go and call vision to come and protect the yeah his kingdom they went to meet…”

children.topic: Real life begins with the guru
children.note:
Jiva Gosvami compares life before initiation to a dream; one's real life begins on waking. Visvanatha Cakravarti adds that when the Lord gives himself, the devotee can see, touch and serve him.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:20 (auto-transcript): “Srila Jeeva Goswami commented that his spiritual master is to be considered or the very self of the disciple. Since real life begins when one is initiated by a bona fide spiritual master. Although one may experience many seemingly wonderful or important event in a dream.…”

The cowherd boys touch, play and eat with Krishna every day, even feeding him their remnants. Maharaj tells how they wanted the fruits of Talavana: equal in strength to Krishna, they still sent him to kill the demon, since a ksatriya should get the credit and they would all enjoy together.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:09 (auto-transcript): “touch him and directly engage in his service the cow head boys are not touching Krishna every day right they don't see him every day they don't play with him every day in fact they give Krishna their remnant the cow head boys they eat food Christian this one is not in a plate…”

Asked by a journalist what the Ratha-yatra festival teaches, Prabhupada answered twice: how God is enjoying — so that you may join. Pure devotees come to do here what they do eternally, and to invite us.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:40 (auto-transcript): “one time the journalist asked probably swamiji this is jaganada festival you are what are you trying to teach us papa said i want to teach you how god is enjoying you don't understand my question he repeated it swamiji i was asking you what are you trying to teach over this…”

We join by hearing, letting that powerful hearing destroy our duplicity and doubts. Pure devotees come not to show their purity but to make us pure; Prabhupada said making one pure devotee would make his attempt a success, and he left that mission with us.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:26 (auto-transcript): “there eternally and at the same time an invitation for us to join let us join by hearing by hearing and we should hear in such a way and allow ourselves so that this powerful hearing will destroy our duplicity destroy our fearlessness destroy our doubts christian requested…”

children.topic: Serve the guru, don't use him
children.note:
The purport warns against engaging the spiritual master for material gain. Maharaj says this is happening seriously in our movement every day. — “every day we are using our spiritual masters for our material gains”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:23 (auto-transcript): “then everything will be nice one should never try to engage the special master in one's personal service with the mentality of loading it over the special master and attaining through him some material again this is going on in our movement this is going on seriously in our…”

Rupa Gosvami's first steps: take shelter of a bona fide guru, take initiation and learn devotional service from him, obey him with faith, and follow the great acaryas under his direction.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:41 (auto-transcript): “has delineated four primary requisites for advancement for the sincere disciple 1. Accepting the shelter or the lottery fee of a bona fide spiritual master, becoming initiated by the spiritual master, and learning how to discharge devotional service from him. obeying the…”

After initiation Narottama dasa Thakura begged Lokanatha Gosvami to teach him how to serve, and was even shown his spiritual identity — a female form while his body was male. Maharaj asks what this teaches: the soul has its own form, and we should use our intelligence properly.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:01 (auto-transcript): “first first of all you have to accept the lotus feet of the special master becoming initiated by special master and learning how to decide what's going on seven years i remember what i wanted to say we should learn from the special master how to devote that word is the good…”

Give the spiritual master our ears, heart and eyes so he can do his duty. Claiming to be surrendered while not following leaves us without advancement; if we truly give ourselves, he will train us and make us pure devotees of Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:25 (auto-transcript): “faithlessness duplicity and duplicity crookedness which will give our life fully to our spiritual masters let them lead our lives successfully by training by destroying our ignorance as we give them our ears give them our heart give them our eyes so they will do their duty…”

maps.title: Become the Disciple · Day 03 · Don't Try to Hide from Your Guru

nodeData.topic: Day 03 · Don't Try to Hide from Your Guru
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.22 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Completing the purport on SB 11.3.22, Maharaj shows through Narottama dasa Thakura that even the perfect accept a guru, and stresses that real hearing of the Bhagavatam removes lamentation, illusion and fear. We hide from our guru to avoid correction, and serve whimsically or professionally instead of to please him. In the questions he explains how to hear one's guru through other speakers and why a departed guru is never absent. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Maharaj returns to the same verse — accepting the guru as life and worshipable deity and serving without duplicity — because the topic is so important. The verse and translation are read again, with Hindi.

Narottama dasa Thakura was already a pure devotee before he came to his spiritual master, yet he too was tested and accepted initiation.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:52 (auto-transcript): “When Narottam Dashekura, he tested, he was tested. Before he came to his own master, he is already a pure devotee. Citizen Mahaprabhu entered into his body. Not the consciousness was transformed, his physical body was transformed.”

Caitanya Mahaprabhu deposited his prema in Narottama, and not only his consciousness but his body was transformed — so much that his own mother walked past without recognising him.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:27 (auto-transcript): “Citizen Mahaprabhu entered into his body. Not the consciousness was transformed, his physical body was transformed. When his mother would look at him, she walked past Narottam Sakurai. I should try to understand. They used to disguise themselves. But what is happening in this…”

Lokanatha Gosvami said there was no need for him to be initiated. Maharaj asks why we take diksa: to be trained for Krishna-prema, to have our ignorance destroyed and be engaged in pure service. Narottama insisted on initiation all the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:12 (auto-transcript): “Lopanath Goswami said, There is no need for you to take initiation from me. Why are we taking diksha? Why are we taking diksha? To be trained to get Christian prayer. A guru should destroy our ignorance. Engages in pure devotional sense.”

What are such pure souls teaching us? That initiation is the standard for everyone, without exception. — “Having a guru is compulsory, even if you are Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:55 (auto-transcript): “Even if you are Krishna, initiation is compulsory. Having a guru is compulsory, even if you are Krishna. This is the standard. He said, which will follow it as it is. Approach his mind.”

The purport says that when one actually hears the Bhagavatam as it is, one becomes free from the desire for sense gratification and is satisfied in Krishna's service.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:44 (auto-transcript): “When one actually hears the sound vibration of Srimad Bhagavatam, as it is, he becomes free from the desire for saint gratification and is happy, satisfied in the service of non-Krishna. We have repeatedly said that we are not hearing.”

Maharaj says he has repeated it many times: we are not hearing. Here it is confirmed by Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati quoting Rupa Gosvami — note the word 'actually'.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:21 (auto-transcript): “We have repeatedly said that we are not hearing. Is it confirmed here? We have said, my chance, we are not hearing. We are not hearing. Is it confirmed? by Srila Rupa Goswami. Srila Bhakti Satswati, he's speaking Koteva Rupa Goswami. He said, when one actually hears,”

When the sound of the Bhagavatam truly enters the ear, the desire for sense gratification and mental speculation goes, and one becomes happy in service. Krishna is not fully manifest in our hearts only because our senses are still covered.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:19 (auto-transcript): “The sound of Bhagavatam enters our ears, two things will happen. The desire for sanctification, mental speculation is Second, that is not the way we put it, I have said it many times, that is 177, my words, we don't hear.”

The Bhagavatam extinguishes these three. If we are not experiencing that, we are not hearing — the loud noise of desire for sense gratification blocks the ear. — “it means you are not hearing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:07 (auto-transcript): “Bhagavatam will distinguish lamentation, delusion, fear. That is Bhagavad. So if we are not experiencing these three things, it means you are not hearing. Why we are not hearing?”

Some say: I will only hear the Bhagavatam, I don't need a guru. Prabhupada spoke every day — but who is hearing? Maharaj adds that people who say only Prabhupada is their guru are often moved by false ego.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:13 (auto-transcript): “So who are you going to vibrate the sound of Bhagavatam for us to hear? Who? This Christian master is not there. I will only hear Bhagavatam. I don't need a guru. God is mine. So I'm the first to hear Bhagavatam. So the Prabhupada is speaking every day.”

If I sleep while chanting, the guru will wake me; if I misbehave, he will correct me. So we keep away from him and do things in hiding, thinking it is simple.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:46 (auto-transcript): “When I'm chanting and sleeping, you wouldn't wake up with me. If I'm chanting and sleeping, you will not wake me up. If I misbehave me, you will correct me. I can hide and do something. And I will think of the simplicity. Some years In 2009, I did Bhakti Shastri here, Brindavan.”

Maharaj recalls a lady from Germany in his Bhakti-sastri course in Vrindavan in 2009, whom he met again years later; her account turned on not being able to hide from her guru. We, by contrast, try to hide so that we will not be corrected.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:24 (auto-transcript): “Some years In 2009, I did Bhakti Shastri here, Brindavan. This is one of us, a lady, from Germany. She was finished. After we finished, some years after, we met here in Brunava. And as he told me, you know,”

Since the Bhagavatam must be heard from a bona fide spiritual master, we should come to class to hear. — “Not to talk, not to discuss, but to hear.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:29 (auto-transcript): “Therefore we should heat, we should sit to hear. We should sit to hear. Not to talk, not to discuss, but to hear. not to cause some destruction. Do management in the class.”

children.topic: No management in class or japa
children.note:
Don't do management in the class or during japa. Prabhupada set separate times for these things; we have mixed everything up.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:10 (auto-transcript): “Do management in the class. Do not do management in Japan. Prabhupada set the time for all these things separately. We are messy of the whole thing. It is not the spiritual master who will suffer. It is we who will suffer for our whimsical acts. Disciples who give themselves…”

It is not the spiritual master who loses when we behave whimsically. — “It is we who will suffer for our whimsical acts.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:36 (auto-transcript): “It is not the spiritual master who will suffer. It is we who will suffer for our whimsical acts. Disciples who give themselves to the spiritual master, He will expertly engage our propensity in loving service of Krishna. Such a transcendental, authorised engagement is called…”

The guru engages the disciple's propensities in Krishna's service; such authorised engagement is bhagavata-dharma. ISKCON has thousands of them — Food for Life, congregational preaching, public relations, cooking, devotee care, fundraising.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:49 (auto-transcript): “Disciples who give themselves to the spiritual master, He will expertly engage our propensity in loving service of Krishna. Such a transcendental, authorised engagement is called Bhagavad-Dharma. Within the International Society for Krishna Consciousness, there are many…”

children.topic: What consciousness do we serve in?
children.note:
The question is not how many activities but the consciousness behind them; training that consciousness is the guru's duty.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:04 (auto-transcript): “But what is our consciousness in doing these activities? That is Guru's duty. Take 64. Papaji. Whimsical activity should not be offered to Krishna. We don't want official devotion.”

Whimsical activity should not be offered to Krishna; we don't want 'official' devotion. Satisfying the spiritual master is satisfying Krishna — that is the disciple's success.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:35 (auto-transcript): “Whimsical activity should not be offered to Krishna. We don't want official devotion. Official devotion. Whimsical activity. Should not be offered. Devotional service of Krishna, who will get it, because Krishna becomes satisfied by it. Satisfaction of the spiritual master,…”

The same services done as a profession are external; done as devotion, they are spiritual.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:44 (auto-transcript): “So many activities. They should be performed as not as a prophet. As a profession, it's external. As devotion, it is spiritual. And by hearing the Siman Bhagavatam, I'm performing such engagement in the society's members' field. The society's members feel relief from Soka…”

children.topic: How do I know I'm advancing?
children.note:
Devotees always ask Maharaj how they can tell they are moving forward in bhakti.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:51 (auto-transcript): “devotees are always asking this question how do I know I'm making advancement How do I know, Maharaj, that I am moving forward to the bhakti? Me. Feeling Krishna and... When our faith is prasad in the Guru and Krishna's ashram, then what will happen? Your whole faith will be…”

When our faith in guru and Krishna is nourished, it grows, while illusion and lamentation decrease. That is the sign.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:22 (auto-transcript): “When our faith is prasad in the Guru and Krishna's ashram, then what will happen? Your whole faith will be nourished. Because our faith is growing. Our faith is growing. Our illusion is decreasing. Lamentation is decreasing. So, we should check interest rates.”

We should regularly check where we are in Krishna consciousness. Without checking we are just floating, with no substance. — “It is our responsibility to do that.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:56 (auto-transcript): “So, we should check interest rates. We should check where we are in Christ. It is our responsibility to do that. If you don't check, it means we are floating. No substance. There's no body. Exist.”

children.topic: A danda doesn't make a sannyasi
children.note:
The purport warns that a so-called Vaishnava who neglects control of body, mind and speech cannot find shelter of a guru, even in the dress and danda of a sannyasi.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:49 (auto-transcript): “According to those who have achieved a mature understanding of the transcendental sound vibration or Srimad Bhagavatam, may I adopt the order of Tridhandi sanyas and describe in the heart of Hamsa Gita.”

Maharaj, part of whose service is training sannyasa candidates, contrasts behaviour in the temple room with behaviour in the street. A mere show of sannyasa is whimsy; the danda by itself makes no one a sannyasi.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:35 (auto-transcript): “Some of our services is to train sanyas kandhi. when we are dreading the conditions, in the street,”

A joke: a cat took sannyasa and became 'His Holiness Cat Swami' — and still eats rats; he took the danda to catch more of them.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:41 (auto-transcript): “After we have a cat sanyasi. His holiness is cat swami. He still eats rot. So Oley took Danda to increase the number of rats to eat. A bona fide Vashemar should work endlessly to free himself from any tinge of saint gratification and mental speculation. and with a loving…”

Two questions on hearing, asked in English and translated into Hindi.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:15 (auto-transcript): “Kishika koin prashne? Thank you very much. The enlivening lecture. So you mentioned that a major way the knowings of sense and education will be drowned is when the spiritual master vibrates in the ear of the disciple so I have two questions relation to this first question is…”

children.topic: Q1 · Must it be my guru?
children.note:
Sense gratification is destroyed when the guru's words enter the ear — but there are thousands of speakers. Does it have to be one's own spiritual master?

🎙 Maharaj at 51:29 (auto-transcript): “Thank you very much. The enlivening lecture. So you mentioned that a major way the knowings of sense and education will be drowned is when the spiritual master vibrates in the ear of the disciple so I have two questions relation to this first question is does it have to be…”

One who has realised the message through his own hearing has the right to speak, and we should listen, provided he has that qualification.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:08 (auto-transcript): “the question is that he has realized a sense of disbelief. through hearing himself. It is called so he can speak.”

The disciple sees whoever sits in the centre as representing his own guru and giving his message. With that attitude he hears, and the result is guaranteed.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:10 (auto-transcript): “Who will see his spiritual master. And whoever is sitting in the center. He will see. This person sitting. He is representing my guru. He will give me message. I'm going to hear you. He will hear. He will hear. He will hear.”

If one can live decades with a guru without really hearing, is that why some very senior devotees go to other institutions after their guru departs?

🎙 Maharaj at 56:07 (auto-transcript): “So, does this justify the situation where very, very senior devotees in our movement, they, because you said the hearing, from the way you have explained hearing, it looks although we have been hearing for several years we are praying for the day that we are going to actually…”

Should such a disciple go outside? No — the spiritual master is always present.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:12 (auto-transcript): “The spiritual master is always present. Present. 11 10 to 10 Prabhupada. One may have a bona fide spiritual master. A bona fide spiritual organization.”

Citing the Gita 10.10–11, which Prabhupada repeated often: even one not intelligent enough to understand, if sincere and engaged in service, is guided by Krishna from within and eventually reaches him. Prabhupada knew what he was giving.

Senior devotees going from one babaji to another are not faithful to Srila Prabhupada; Maharaj calls it a shame.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:50 (auto-transcript): “So, some of our senior devotees who are going to that Babaji and that Babaji to hear, They are not faithful to Srila Prabhupada, they are not chaste, I will say it, I don't know who are the people but it's a shame,”

children.topic: My guru sits here with me
children.note:
Maharaj's own spiritual master has left — did anyone see him going elsewhere? His guru, and Prabhupada, sit with him and speak; if you don't see it, that is your problem. Before leaving his guru blessed him: wherever you go, you will see me. — “I have never felt that my Guru has left me.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:44 (auto-transcript): “My spiritual master left. Did you see me going anywhere? Should I tell you my false ego? You want to hear my false ego? I should tell you my false ego? I don't have bhakti, but false ego. Should I show you my false ego? My spiritual master is sitting here with me. If you…”

Serve the guru as worshipable deity without duplicity and Krishna gives himself; duplicitous, we keep searching. So many great devotees speak in this one purport — heard properly, our problem would vanish.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:59 (auto-transcript): “She will serve our spiritual master, our worshipable deity, without duplicity. And Krishna will give himself to us. When we are duplicitous, without blessing of your master and Krishna.”

maps.title: Become the Disciple · Day 04 · Is Guru Partial?

nodeData.note: SB 11.3.23 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On SB 11.3.23 Maharaj asks whether a guru is partial, answering with Dronacarya's explanation of why Arjuna excelled: the same training was given to all, but Arjuna had Krishna as friend and practised through the night. He urges seniors to invest patiently in juniors, laments putting new devotees into high positions, and explains Vaishnava etiquette from the Panihati festival. Questions cover arrogant juniors, controlling the mind, laziness, and why Balarama trained Duryodhana. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse tells the disciple to detach the mind from matter, cultivate the company of the guru and saintly devotees, and deal properly with every living being — mercy, friendship and respect as fitting.

The purport, citing the Garuda Purana, ranks demigods, great sages and pious humans as saintly within the modes of nature, while the devotee who never falls from bhakti is beyond the modes, as the Gita 14.26 says.

The spiritual master trains the disciple's mind in Krishna consciousness; the disciple listens carefully, hears and practises, and so the mind gives up material things.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:15 (auto-transcript): “The spiritual master teaches. Train the devotee is the mind in Krishna consciousness, so disciples listen carefully, try hearing, practice. the mind will”

Maharaj tells a Mahabharata episode to answer the question of the day: is the guru partial?

🎙 Maharaj at 26:37 (auto-transcript): “they went to Adunachari and they asked Dronacharya what did you give to Arjuna that dick Dronacharya said nothing the same trini I gave to all of you then why Arjuna is different Dronacharya said Two things.”

Drona gave two reasons. First, Arjuna has Krishna as his friend — are you Krishna's friend? No. That makes him superior to you.

Second, by day Drona taught everyone the same; at night the others slept while Arjuna practised all night long. That extra effort is why he is special. — “Arjuna put extra effort in his practice.”

When the spiritual master gives the same training to all, the differences come from how each disciple applies it, not from the guru. — “it is from the disciples themselves”

What do we do in the mind before coming to the guru, while with him, and after leaving? Does the mind stay material or become spiritual? Our advancement depends on that application. Do we have Arjuna's mentality, or only expectations?

🎙 Maharaj at 29:37 (auto-transcript): “When we are the spiritual master What do we do when we are there? What do we do before we come to him? What do we do after leaving him? What do we do before coming? While we are there and after living, what is our thing?”

As Prabhupada said, it will be tested, and the result is visible directly. When the disciple responds positively to what the guru gives, Krishna comes — as Arjuna's strength became a challenge to everyone.

Narada Muni gives the formula for crossing material miseries: be merciful to those below us, take interest in them and invest in them. What we sacrifice now matures in them, and they become better representatives tomorrow.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:21 (auto-transcript): “Shri Narada Muni said, this is the formula for transcending terrible miseries. want to transcend the three, four, this is the formula, those who are ill, we should be merciful, show them mercy, take interest in them, invest in them,”

In Krishna consciousness it takes time; we cannot demand the result now. Maharaj recalls Caitanya Mahaprabhu planting a mango tree and the fruit ripening in due course.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:49 (auto-transcript): “In pure Krishna consciousness, it will take some time to think that, now I want the result. Accept your Lord Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, who planted mango. and he grows the fruit became ripe only chitam all investments”

In Kenya there are rich, tasty macadamia nuts. But the trees take so long to bear that the people who plant them are not the ones who eat them. If no one plants because they won't eat, nothing wonderful happens in life. — “persons who plant macadamia never eat it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:36 (auto-transcript): “you know macadamia is gone Kenya You get a lot of danya. It's very greasy and tasty. Is it true?”

Since juniors are below us, we should not exploit them or confuse them; we should take interest in them.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:21 (auto-transcript): “investment you should make investment take interest in since you are lower than us you should not exploit them you should not confuse them We should go.”

Like holding a child's hand with the chalk to teach her to write, cultivate and guide new devotees. It is an investment, and we have to learn to do it.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:32 (auto-transcript): “So cultivate, guide them, like a child's hand or this chalk. To teach her to write. It's an investment. You have to learn to do that.”

This is not going on in our movement. It breaks Maharaj's heart to see new, young devotees put into high positions because of material qualifications: they lack the needed bhakti, become anxious and turn into politicians — all in the name of empowerment. — “It is disempowerment.”

Those who took initiation and grew up in devotion together are equals, to be honoured and served. Rupa Gosvami explains all this later; when the system is followed we advance.

children.note:
If a senior tries to train a junior who is proud, doesn't listen and acts like the boss, what should the senior do?

🎙 Maharaj at 50:05 (auto-transcript): “Shrila Gurudev, the question is like you said, that one who is senior, he should very gently take care and train the junior devotee but what what should junior do when senior is telling he's trying to help or engage but he's very much proud he”

When the boss walks in and needs something urgently, you are absorbed and ignore distractions, even calls. Do service with that absorption and the mind, fully engaged, becomes one with the seva.

nodeData.topic: Day 05 · Going to a Guru: To Serve or to Take?
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.23 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Continuing SB 11.3.23, Maharaj explains that everyone in this world, even the demigods, is under the modes of nature, and only steady devotional practice lifts us above them. A pure devotee has spiritual rather than mystic power, as Haridasa Thakura showed in Santipur. We should approach a guru to hear and serve rather than to take, avoid those who only make a show of chanting, and treat each devotee according to their real level. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse on detaching the mind and associating rightly is recalled with Hindi, and the purport continues: since no one in the material world is free from the modes, one should seek the company of a pure devotee and avoid materialists, even ones who outwardly chant.

children.topic: Everything is within the three modes
children.note:
Gita chapter 17 shows that food, our attitude in eating, faith, sacrifice, charity, knowledge — even devotion — come in three modes. The demigods are not exempt.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:10 (auto-transcript): “or Gita chapter 17 explains that everything is within the three more two minutes. Our food our attitude in eating in the mood before them.”

children.topic: A brahmana's food, a sudra's food
children.note:
A brahmana's food should be in goodness. A sudra can eat contaminated food without getting sick; a brahmana who eats it falls ill. A 'brahmana' eating flesh is neither brahmana nor sudra — a very dangerous position.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:39 (auto-transcript): “Our food our attitude in eating in the mood before them. The Bhagavatam will see that a Brahmana's food should be in goodness.”

Some mornings we wake happy and the rounds just flow after mangala-arati; next day we are too tired and sleep ten hours. Goodness, passion and ignorance keep competing until we transcend them.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:51 (auto-transcript): “Sometimes you wake up in the morning and you are very happy. Sixty-four hours just flow. After Mangalati. Next, too tired from the japa, too early. I sleep for 10 hours. From goodness to who?”
How to transcend the modes? The Gita (13 and 14) speaks of unalloyed, unbroken devotional service: steady practice without falling away.

children.topic: Office at eight, then at four
children.note:
If you go to the office at eight one day, at four the next, then after two days, then after a week — will you succeed in that business? No. To succeed we must be steady, even before we see any change.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:07 (auto-transcript): “Even materially speaking, if you go to office, 8 o'clock today, tomorrow, 4 pm, after two days, and you go again in the afternoon after one week you will go you succeed in that business?”

Even if you still doze during japa, it doesn't matter — just continue. You say it isn't working, but if it weren't you would have stopped; the results become obvious as practice matures. — “The desire to continue means it is working.”

Demigods can produce fire from their mouths — a display of passion. Don't think your guru is inferior because he shows no mystic power; a pure devotee does not care for it. He can make you a pure devotee, which no demigod can. — “Spiritual power is superior to mystic power.”

children.topic: Advaita Acarya and the Durga deity
children.note:
In Santipur, where Haridasa Thakura lived with Advaita Acarya, people entered a Durga temple and Advaita did not bow, saying she would not accept his obeisance. When they insisted and he bowed, the deity disappeared, and returned only when they installed Lord Vishnu as well.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:09 (auto-transcript): “Do you know what? In Shantipur, Haridash Thakura was living with Advatacharya. So, one day Advaita Acharya, with his father and other people around, they entered Durga temple, the all of obeisances. Adwetacharya didn't have obeisances.”

Still the people insulted Haridasa Thakura. Advaita asked him to show the less intelligent something. For days no fire would light in Santipur and no one could cook. Advaita sent them to beg from Haridasa; when they did, their fires lit — and they invited the 'sudra' to eat first and honoured his remnants.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:37 (auto-transcript): “And then, they didn't learn a lesson. They were also insulting Haridas Sakura. So, Advatachara told Haridas, less intelligent people, they need miracle to understand to protect them from offenses they are making towards you I will show them my own”

Pure devotees are beyond the modes and don't waste time on mystic power. By preaching pure Krishna consciousness they destroy people's karma and the ignorance in their hearts — only they can do that.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:50 (auto-transcript): “Devotees are free from the modes, the three modes. The demigods are not free. We should understand this. children.topic: Go to the guru to serve
children.note:

children.topic: When you are ready to hear
children.note:
We go to a pure devotee when we are ready to hear, to practise, to follow Krishna consciousness and to go back to Godhead.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:52 (auto-transcript): “For that one should go to a pure devotee. we should go to a pure devotee when our interest is that we are ready to hear. We are ready to practice. Maharaj stresses the purport's wording: one who seriously wants real happiness must — not may — seek a bona fide spiritual master and take initiation. If you are not chanting, why go to a guru?

Seriousness means being ready to give up everything unnecessary and accept everything necessary, liked or not. Then the guru's training is easy. — “but I am ready to accept that which is necessary.”

A musician needed 22 attempts in the studio to record a single song; frustrated, he still continued, and it became a hit. We try for two minutes and ask Krishna why he makes it so difficult.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:41 (auto-transcript): “There is one music chant to make one record. Music is a... Okay, let me put it here. He was in a recording studio to sing, he couldn't get a meter. In music, all these things we are doing, if you go to a studio, even if you go to play karatas,”

If sleepy, stand up and walk around — Prabhupada did this. Krishna is not after our expertise. Be ready for tests, keep begging for strength, and keep trying. — “Krishna wants our sincere effort”
