nodeData.topic: Day 11 · Gossip: The Silent Killer of Devotional Strength
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains mauna, silence, not as an empty mouth but as speaking only of Krishna, which brings gravity, respect and control of the other senses. He warns that gossip, in its old village form and its new electronic form, drains our spiritual strength and our japa, and answers questions on people who interrupt japa and on sharing spiritual experiences. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Today's quality from the verse is silence. The purport explains it as avoiding worthless talk and speaking instead of what really matters — going back to Godhead.

children.topic: Not the silence of a stone
children.note:
Sitting empty-headed is not silence. Srila Prabhupada's meaning is to speak about Krishna twenty-four hours a day — that is perfect silence.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:14 (auto-transcript): “That is no silence. That is not silence. Silence is different. This Shilupapa said that silence me to speak about Krishna 24 hours. Talking about Krishna throughout.”

children.topic: We speak mostly in the mind
children.note:
Closing the mouth does not stop speech; most of our speaking happens mentally, and the quality of those thoughts implicates us and shows what we really are. — “actually we speak mentally more than vocally”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:03 (auto-transcript): “it is silence perfect silence even if we don't speak vocally we are going to speak mentally actually we speak mentally more than vocally to physically close one's mouth doesn't mean one is not speaking we are always speaking 80% of our speech is not vocal”

Because a devotee speaks only of Krishna, he has no time for nonsense. Those who chant constantly, their minds absorbed in Krishna, are practising silence in the best way.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:32 (auto-transcript): “So a devotee speaks only about Krishna. That is positive. And because he's speaking about Krishna he's not speaking about nonsensical things. It is the best practice of silence. It's a verse quoted here from Srimad Bhagavatam. If I'm not mistaken, it's from 1st counter,…”

A vow never to talk is impossible, since the mind talks constantly. The real rule is simpler: if you have nothing of Krishna to say, keep quiet and let those who know speak.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:09 (auto-transcript): “We already mentioned It's not possible. We are talking in the mind. Always we are talking. The mind is talking constantly. So there's no question of being silent. All together. And that is suitable for those who have nothing sensible to speak about. if you have nothing…”

Talk that is not about Krishna is like a frog croaking — it only announces dinner to the snake, which comes and eats it. Better to be quiet and hear from those with something to tell us. — “My dear snake, you're hungry, I'm here.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:28 (auto-transcript): “if we are not going to talk about Krishna and we are talking we are talking like a croc The cocking of a frog. The frog is cocking. But what is the benefit of that? The benefit is inviting a snake for fish. My dear snake, you're hungry, I'm here. Your food is available.”

The essence of silence is control of speech, which for devotees means avoiding idle talk and gossip. Gossip has a powerful negative effect and leaves one spiritually dry.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:43 (auto-transcript): “However, the essence of Mauna is control of speech. And for devotees that, that means avoiding frivolous talk or gossip. I am talking about Krishna only. That is the perfection of remaining silent. Talk only about Krishna. we have discussed many times”

A car with a flat tyre cannot move; those who spend their time gossiping make no spiritual advancement because they are depleted. — “Gossipers cannot make advancement.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:06 (auto-transcript): “we give example if you have a flat tire you cannot move meaning meaning that Those who spend their time in gossiping does not make spiritual advancement. Just like a flat tire cannot move, a car wouldn't move.”

A silent person's mind is not easily read; that is gravity, one of the twenty-six qualities of a devotee, and it grows from not gossiping and speaking only of Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:05 (auto-transcript): “The effect was so silent is that others cannot readily know what is on one's mind. mind that is the definition of gravity gravity is developed by silence Salim means we are not talking, we are not gossiping, no idle talks, only about Krishna.”

Gravity is a spiritually developed mind that clearly sees right and wrong and cannot be pushed about. Maharaj recalls a devotee whose idea of gravity Srila Prabhupada corrected: it is not an outward pose.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:17 (auto-transcript): “Gravity. Gravity means what? The mind is developed spiritually. One can clearly distinguish what is wrong, what is right. There is no question of being pushed. One devotee is beating gravity Prabhupada said, what is that?”

Silence is the key to secrecy. Grave people are hard to read, while speaking reveals what is in the mind; and when such a person does speak, the words land like a thunderbolt. Krishna says that among secret things he is silence.

If you really want to control your speech, study and recite the Vedas; one so absorbed never speaks nonsense, develops gravity and speaks with potency.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:55 (auto-transcript): “If you want to really control the speech study the Vedas study the Vedas recite the Vedas who can never speak nonsense It will develop gravity. It will be potency. In one speech, it will be potency.”

Speech and taste both depend on the tongue. Control speaking and eating comes under control; control eating and the other senses follow.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:12 (auto-transcript): “Additionally, because both speech and taste are dependent on the tongue, they are interrelated. Devotees must therefore control their speaking habit, speaking habit, in order to control their eating habit.”

Like celibacy, silence is taken as a vow of self-discipline: speak only of things related to Krishna, directly or indirectly. Since everything comes from the mind, the mind must be controlled. — “the mind has to be controlled.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:18 (auto-transcript): “We are accepting a self-composed vow, self-composed vow. Self-discipline. There is no secret what such a vow will entail.”

children.topic: Association of the Lord in study
children.note:
Deep study of scripture is very powerful because one has the direct association of the Lord and all the acaryas; the senses become absorbed in Krishna and one grows mindful of everything one does.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:11 (auto-transcript): “it is very powerful to study the scriptures deeply Very powerful, very powerful, because one is having direct association of the Lord, and all Acharyas, so the senses are fully absorbed in Krishna, One becomes mindful of everything that we do.”

People who talk constantly about everything but Krishna may entertain for a while, but cultured and mature people never respect them. A silent person is respected.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:51 (auto-transcript): “Those who are always talking, talking, talking, not about Krishna, but about something else. They have no respect anywhere. Cultural people, devotees, mature people, they will never have respect for such people. A silent person is always respected.”

Students begged their master to speak to them all the time. He replied that he is talking every day and only sometimes gives a discourse — his daily life is the preaching. That is silence and gravity.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:46 (auto-transcript): “One experienced Christian, One of his students asked him, Dear Master, we always want you to preach, but you don't always speak with us, we want you to speak all the time, but you are not doing that, Can you always speak to us? So he said, I am always talking.”

Krishnadasa Kaviraja Gosvami describes the eloquent speaker as one who speaks concisely, about what benefits the whole world. The topic and object of our talk must be Krishna; that is a powerful austerity.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:28 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna Dasgavra Goswami said he's an eloquent speaker. Eloquent speaker. Who speak concisely. Spoken consciously is eloquence. So the topic of discussion and the object of discussion must be Krishna.”

Ask what we are discussing, about whom, and what we hope to gain. Talk of Krishna is different: you are never tired, and the more you speak the more strength you get. — “speak about Krishna the whole day”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:16 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we should consider what is the topic of our discussion. We must consider that. what is the topic of our discussion and we are talking about who what do we hope to gain speak about Krishna the whole day you'll never be tired the more you talk the more strength…”

The highest form of speech is sankirtan: chanting and speaking of Krishna liberates, purifies the heart and makes one hungry for more sankirtan.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:15 (auto-transcript): “Indeed, the best form of speech is Sankirtan. talking about Krishna I was chanting his names that form of speech not only liberates but purifies the heart and makes one addicted to further Sankirtan.”

Maharaj recites Caitanya Mahaprabhu's famous instructions to Raghunatha dasa Gosvami — avoid ordinary talk and its hearing, simple food and dress, give respect without seeking it, chant constantly and serve Radha and Krishna within — and calls this real mauna.

Guarding against gossip begins with caution in what we hear. Village talk today is debate about sports, politics and the weather — which party will win, whether India will beat South Africa.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:13 (auto-transcript): “Gossip idol talks It begins by exercising caution in hearing village talk. To be concise that means gossip. Village talk is gossip. Listen.”

Radio, internet surfing, television, films and forwarding their content are gossip in electronic form — very prominent and very destructive.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:31 (auto-transcript): “Electronic Gossip Very prominent Very destructive What is affecting devotees Japa the most? What is affecting devotees Japa the most? Internet, shopping, mobile, till one o'clock.”

Maharaj asks what most damages devotees' japa: internet, shopping, the phone till one in the morning. That kills brahma-muhurta, and with it we reject Krishna's invitation and shrink our own fortune. — “Yes, electronic media is destructive association.”

🎙 Maharaj at 49:02 (auto-transcript): “Internet, shopping, mobile, till one o'clock. And what is it we are looking at? Hainam, Sankirtan, Dhatayatra, Faisal. Saying get a vacation. That destroy our Brahma Mughurta.”

Gossip drains our spiritual account until even a devotee can go bankrupt. From his music days Maharaj recalls a famous American singer of the 1960s ruined by drugs and debt, whose dubious comeback ended when his own father shot him. Unlike the Avanti brahmana, he could not take his fall as a chance to turn to God.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:31 (auto-transcript): “GOSHIP DEBLETING OUR SPIRITUAL BANK ACCOUNTS Bolognians can become bankrupt it has happened in an year becoming bankrupt because I'm from music I can tell you music set”

We come to the guru to hear and then live what we hear. Why leave home only to sleep in class? Maharaj recalls a devotee who pushed through a packed hall, sat in front of senior sannyasis and then took a phone call in full view.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:43 (auto-transcript): “She does not just hear these things. She does not just hear these things. She does not just hear them. Practice them. Then it will become a reality. That is what we want. We want to experience what we are hearing from the scriptures. we just waste our time come and sit with…”

Two questions: people who want to talk during japa, and whether to share spiritual experiences.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:28 (auto-transcript): “Comment. Do you think I'm going to take it for you? Take it for you to do it. So my question is, sometimes when I'm practicing, you know, genuinely, seriously, when you're signing, but someone comes and they find you is not good and they want to speak with me or something. So…”

children.topic: Q1 · Someone talks during my japa
children.note:
When I chant seriously, someone comes to talk; I compromise so as not to alienate them, but my focus goes. What is the right approach?

🎙 Maharaj at 61:38 (auto-transcript): “So my question is, sometimes when I'm practicing, you know, genuinely, seriously, when you're signing, but someone comes and they find you is not good and they want to speak with me or something. So you feel, okay, maybe you are going to accommodate them and loosen up a…”

For one who really wants to chant, a person who distracts from japa is an enemy, however important the talk is made to seem. — “a friend will encourage you to chant”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:00 (auto-transcript): “That's an enemy, for one who really wants to chant, it's an enemy, to declare it very clearly, It's not a friend, a friend will encourage you to chant, and then they want to distract you from chant. Yes, I wondered what he was asking me a question, but he was very clever.”

children.topic: So what if they call you proud?
children.note:
Of billions on the planet, how many chant Hare Krishna? Even chanting mechanically, you have begun the journey. And whatever you do, some will still call you proud.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:14 (auto-transcript): “if I don't discuss the person is going to say I'm proud and then what if you are proud then what so what yes I should be proud that I'm chanting Harkis how many people have chant Harkis in this world how many people I would talk to 2 million even we have to 1 billion 10…”

Time for japa, give attention to japa; time for Bhagavatam, hear it; time for prasadam, sleep or service, do that. Srila Prabhupada designed it; the scripture is clear until we bring our crookedness into it. — “Don't mix everything up.”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:23 (auto-transcript): “This is the time I pray. Yes. Time for Japa. Give attention to Japa. Time for Bhagavatam. Hear Bhagavatam. Time for Prasadam. Take Prasad. Time for sleep. Time for other services. Do their services. Papa designed all these things. We should just follow it. Don't mix…”

children.topic: Q2 · Share realisations or keep them?
children.note:
Does sharing a spiritual experience dilute it, and does keeping it inside make it stronger?

🎙 Maharaj at 68:10 (auto-transcript): “I was thinking about this earlier today. When we have certain experiences in our devotional time or some specific locations, so one tendency is to share it with our peers, our friends and feel happy about it that I've experienced something. And the other is we keep it within.…”

Some things are only for a certain class of people. Tell friends you danced with Krishna all night and they will call it a joke. There is even a principle for dreams: told at once, a good dream is neutralised and turns into pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:46 (auto-transcript): “There are certain things which are called confidential. It is for a certain class of people. If you tell your friends, this night I will dancing with Krishna this night”

Days before leaving, Maharaj's spiritual master hesitated over whether revealing a confidence might be pride. People are envious, even our closest friends; some things may be said, but look at whom you are telling.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:29 (auto-transcript): “there is a principle she didn't share it immediately If you see a dream immediately, you neutralize the good one, you neutralize everything. It becomes like a pride. I remember my special master said, I don't know whether I should say this, would it be a pride or not? When he…”

maps.title: Become the Disciple · Day 12 · Not Reading the Scriptures is Also an Offence

nodeData.topic: Day 12 · Not Reading the Scriptures is Also an Offence
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes up svadhyaya, study of scripture: Srila Prabhupada's books gather all the acaryas in one place, and studying them fills the heart with determination to serve, while neglecting them is an offence. Through Visvarupa and the boy Nimai he shows what real study does, urges devotees to learn mantras and feast daily on the scriptures, and answers questions on why the desire to serve changes, on knowledge versus information, and on finding time to study. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Today's quality from the verse is study of Vedic literature, each according to his ability, and teaching others. The purport points especially to Srila Prabhupada's books.

children.topic: All the acaryas in Prabhupada's books
children.note:
Bhagavatam, Bhagavad-gita, Nectar of Instruction, Nectar of Devotion, Caitanya-caritamrta: Srila Prabhupada collected the commentaries and realisations of all our acaryas into them, so reading his books carefully is reading theirs. — “All these books have everything you need to become Krishna conscious.”

🎙 Maharaj at 10:12 (auto-transcript): “We have so many books given by Siddha Prabhupada. Principally, we are studying Bhagavatam, Bhagavad Gita, Lecture of Instruction, Lecture of Devotion, Siddha Prabhupada, Chaitan Chaita Tambrit. All this Prabhupada has given to us. Shri Chaitanya Mahabharata. All these books…”

Rather than spend time on activities that destroy bhakti, engage in these books — not to become a scholar but to become Krishna conscious. — “The intention is not to become a big scholar.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:31 (auto-transcript): “instead of wasting our time for unnecessary activities that would destroy our bhakti. Better to engage ourselves in these books. The intention is not to become a big scholar. Studying the Vedas helps to control our speech.”

Study controls speech and the tongue and builds love for Krishna, because his qualities are clearly described. Reading the Tenth Canto, the mind naturally goes to Krishna's activities.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:03 (auto-transcript): “Studying the Vedas helps to control our speech. It will control our tongue. It will help us to develop love for Krishna. because Krishna's qualities are clearly defined. When you look at the 10th kanto of Bhagavatam,”

If we do not read the scriptures we offend them, disregard Srila Prabhupada's instructions and deny ourselves what the acaryas laboured to give us.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:30 (auto-transcript): “So we discussed the other day if we don't read our scriptures we are naturally offenders. We are offending the scriptures. breaking the destructions for Srila Prabhupada we deny ourselves to the massive of acharyas because they spend their time nectar of devotion Srila…”

One studies two hours, another thirty minutes, another an hour — according to schedule and according to desire. Everyone should engage.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:58 (auto-transcript): “So I couldn't have our ability to study them. Someone may study for two hours. Someone has 30 minutes. Someone, maybe one hour. According to our schedule, or base our desire. According to our desire. We should engage ourselves. It is said here, one becomes a few words, the…”

In a civilised society children began study at five. Studying the Vedas from childhood gives a solid foundation, so one already knows what to do and what to expect in life.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:44 (auto-transcript): “So, in a civilized age, at the age of five, five, children are sent to Gurkul. For what? For what? to study initiated into study. That is a foundation for our life.”

Maharaj dwells on a phrase from the purport: proper study creates courage and determination in the heart to serve the Lord, and leaves no determination for sense gratification. He calls it a very powerful word.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:10 (auto-transcript): “When you study the scripture very nicely. Do you know? I'm looking at this word very carefully. what becomes infused with a static determinist one to serve the supreme prestige of Godhead is his courage from studying the scriptures determination is created in the heart…”

Saci-mata's elder son Visvarupa studied the Vedas under Advaita Acarya, lost interest in everything else and left home to serve the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:06 (auto-transcript): “Sachi Mata She said My son What's your name? Vishwarup. Study the Vedas under Dvita Acharya. What happened? What happened? One becomes in fear with determination to serve the”
Study has two possible effects depending on our motive. Studied properly it makes one naturally humble, as Bhagavad-gita 5.18 describes; studied with another desire it makes one proud.

As one flushes stool without a second look, real study throws out material desire as trash. Nobody wants to inspect yesterday's gulab jamuns, rasagullas and pizzas. — “This is what happens when one study the Vedas properly.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:29 (auto-transcript): “Exactly like when one passes stool, what do you do? Flush it, right? Exactly. This is what happens when one study the Vedas properly. Material desire, completely thrown out. Oh, this is trash. Not even second. Yesterday, I took gulab jamons, rasa gulabs, and sundaes,”

Fearing Nimai would leave like his brother, Jagannatha Misra stopped his studies, saying Krishna, not education, maintains us. Nimai sat on discarded cooking pots and would not come down, arguing that if all is earth, food and pots are the same; when Saci-mata explained the difference, he asked how he could learn such things without school — and was allowed back. He needed no study, but was teaching us that we do.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:04 (auto-transcript): “was not happy were that then when Jagannam Srta. Chita Mahaprabhu was addicted also in his study they said Disharupa, he lived after stuttering the Vedas. We could tolerate it because we have the face of Nimai Pandit to look at. Now he is stuttering the Vedas too scrutinizingly.”

Study is not just reading; it becomes absorption. To be 'infused' means Krishna's energy enters and spreads through our consciousness. In Prabhupada's books Svarupa Damodara, Raghunatha, Rupa, Sanatana, Jiva and many others are all in one place, and material desire quietly goes away. — “So studying the Vedas is association with Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:45 (auto-transcript): “This is study. Not just reading. You study. Look at the word carefully. that becomes absorption the absorption is Krishna consciousness one becomes infused means what the energy from Krishna is entering into us spread through all our consciousness Krishna consciousness…”

We eat with the tongue; we should also feed it with Krishna's glories. Srila Prabhupada recommended every devotee learn to chant mantras, because they will save us at death.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:10 (auto-transcript): “This is the story of the Great House. This compulsory we eat with the tongue we should eat also by chanting the glories of Krishna vibrating these mantras. Lepapa recommended every devotee should learn chanting mantras because it will save us at the time of death.”

As an elephant Gajendra chanted no new mantras; he remembered prayers learned as a king in his previous life, and Krishna appeared.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:57 (auto-transcript): “He was speaking because of Gajendra. Gajendra chanted the mantra he learned from past life. Not the present life. the person as an animal he didn't chant mantras the previous life as a king he chanted many mantras that helped him in the next life but he chanted the mantras he…”

The Bhagavatam, the Gita, the Siksastaka, the Brahma-samhita, the Nrsimha-kavaca, the Radha-krpa-kataksa — so many. Engaged in them we are automatically saved from prajalpa, and at japa the mind stays with the mantra.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:51 (auto-transcript): “There are so many mantras in Bhagavatam. Bhagavad Gita, lots of instructions, Shri Shokamishar, tend to come to so many mantras. Brahma Samitai says, Shri Satsakam is said, So many. The Sengha Kavachar is there. So many. Radha Kripa Kutakshar is there. So many. Let's engage…”

During a month-long observance many devotees found themselves chanting the prayers in their dreams. If one month does that, why not a lifetime? Maharaj's answer: laziness — give it up. — “how we are cheating ourselves”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:56 (auto-transcript): “last time when we were observing Gorshatan Ma for one month just for one month many devotees confess as the mantra was chanting they continue to chant them in their dream that is for one month for a lifetime can we see how we are cheating ourselves can we see we are cheating…”

The scriptures say get up — get up and see the feast waiting. If we do not feast on them we stay hungry and eat prajalpa instead; we must eat something, so eat what has been given. — “We should eat what is proper”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:16 (auto-transcript): “so in the scripture you will hear get up get up means what to study the scriptures to study the scriptures yes get up look at the scriptures see what is available see what is waiting for us feast we have feast right we have lot of feast let us feast everyday if you don't…”

The Gosvamis wrote every day here in Vrindavan. You cannot write without thinking, just as you cannot phone someone without thinking of them; absorbed in Krishna, they wrote it down for us. Not studying disobeys the acaryas.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:35 (auto-transcript): “This is what the Goswami's were doing every day here. Every day they are busy writing. You cannot write something you are not chanting. Before you write something you are thinking about it. Right? Just like before you call somebody, you are thinking about that person. You…”

Not speculation or reading for prestige. Maharaj asks the sign of knowledge: humility, and renunciation — everything else becomes trash because one is nourished by Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:53 (auto-transcript): “What is the sign that one has knowledge? We already mentioned one thing, one becomes very humble. What is the sign that one has knowledge? What is the sign that this person is knowledgeable. What do you see in the person that has knowledge, qualities? The person is renounced.…”

Looking through the Sixth Canto the day before, Maharaj laughed to see how much nectar is inside while we do not eat it. Please don't starve — eat.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:51 (auto-transcript): “I was laughing yesterday when I was looking at the Ciscanto and the nectar was there I was looking and see how we are cheating ourselves so much nectar is inside we are not eating please don't starve yourself eat eat Hare Krishna make comments”

Three questions: the changing motive for study, knowledge versus information, and householders with no time.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:35 (auto-transcript): “make comments questions yes in the beginning we all have a desire to practice the host and service in the same way then let me I see some of what happens When he starts writing scriptures with that desire, I don't know at what point that desire starts shaping that it becomes…”

children.topic: Q1 · Why does the motive change?
children.note:
We begin studying to serve, but at some point the desire turns to scholarship and speaking for recognition. When and why does it change?

🎙 Maharaj at 42:43 (auto-transcript): “in the beginning we all have a desire to practice the host and service in the same way then let me I see some of what happens When he starts writing scriptures with that desire, I don't know at what point that desire starts shaping that it becomes now more inclined to become…”

A subtle hidden desire must first be cleared. Krishna knows us better than we do, yet asks: is it me you are looking for in the scriptures, or something else? He tests us so that we define where we belong. — “Krishna wants you to decide.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:20 (auto-transcript): “When we studied the scripture, just like anything else we want to do, The result, there is the result to come out. First of all, we have to get the subtle desire which I've been hiding there cleared. We should always be conscious”

Sarasvati told Kesava Kasmiri that the mantra she gave him was for Krishna consciousness, not to make him a conquering scholar — but he changed. Scripture can become entertainment for the intellect.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:10 (auto-transcript): “Saraswati told Kisawa Kasmiri, the purpose of the mantra I gave you is not to become a Dig Vijay. That was not the reason. I gave you for Krishna consciousness but you changed. So Krishna wants to he wants us to clearly define where we are. So he made the test.”

Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura comments on Sukadeva's phrase. Praised all day as a great prabhu, a devotee starts to believe it; the fortunate one is shaken, sees what he has become and takes shelter of Krishna. That fear is the turning point.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:24 (auto-transcript): “Shilabhishwana Chakrabhati Takwala explains that Sukadev Goswami used the word fear of cancer. Fear of kamsa. Sukhadev Goswami used the word boldly in the Bhagavata. Vishnu Takvati gave purport to that. What is fear of kamsa? In one Dhammaswami lecture, I say fear of kamsa is…”

Gour Govinda Maharaj lamented that sincere newcomers become politicians after some years. A service given becomes a position — dangerous; the fortunate humble themselves and return to bhakti. — “we came here as sincere boys and girls.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:08 (auto-transcript): “They will continue. As Srila Gurguvina Maharaj said, we came here as sincere boys and girls. After some years, after some years, now we are politicians, no more devotees. One who is fortunate at the point, see what I'm doing. I mean persecuted by a position instead of…”

Position-seekers meet, rest and eat but do not chant; the fortunate find someone to tell them they have become a boss. A senior sannyasi once proposed going to Jagannatha temple to dance and then to the Ganga instead of a meeting. Maharaj has seen devotees leave their bodies lamenting what they leave behind — so take sadhana seriously now.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:55 (auto-transcript): “You see, many so-called sino devotees want a position they are not chanting the Japa. Eating throughout the whole day and night. They are meeting, they are resting or eating. So how will they change? Those who are fortunate, they will get somebody who will tell them, you are…”

A question about understanding the mahajanas and the true objective of knowledge.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:27 (auto-transcript): “It's a great question. Its question is, the question of knowledge should be the objective of knowing. Today, knowledge is a little bit. We need to make a bug also. We will go to google and check how it works. If you go to Google and get a recipe, you start to prepare some things.”

Finding a recipe on Google and never cooking it is just information; reading books in detail without application is the same. Applied knowledge becomes realisation — as they say in West Africa, half knowledge is dangerous. — “it is not knowledge, it's an information.”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:48 (auto-transcript): “We will go to google and check how it works. If you go to Google and get a recipe, you start to prepare some things. But you don't practice it. What is that? It's just information. It has no value.”

Who decides who worships the deity, cooks or does sankirtan? It is already within us, and a guru once revealed it early. Today a born businessman is sent to be an aeronautical engineer and called dull; placed where his nature lies, he rises at once.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:48 (auto-transcript): “So who decides who should do deity worship, who should do pujas, who should do cooking, who should do sankitan, who should do, who decides? It is already inside us. We came with these things. So when we are sent to the Guru in the beginning all these things are taught.”

Householders must work hard for years before they have time to study deeply. How can they avoid lamenting and still serve?

🎙 Maharaj at 63:13 (auto-transcript): “The question says, Griyastas, we need to study and work hard in fields of avidya for several years at the beginning of their career before they finally gain substantial time to dwell very deeply to Vedang and Shastras. Since such Shastrit study requires considerably cognitive…”

We have twenty-four hours; make it thirty-six and we would still have no time. The lack is interest — with interest, time appears, and what we like feels simple.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:28 (auto-transcript): “First of all, It is not because you don't have time. We don't have interest. We have 24 hours. So Christians should make it 36. Even if Christians make it 36, we still have no time. But if we have interest, we will have time. so the things we don't like they are difficult…”
Even without an appetite for reading one can hear: everything is now on the phone, in every language. Krishna says those who worship after hearing from others also cross beyond birth and death.

maps.title: Become the Disciple · Day 13 · If You are Dishonest with Guru, Who are You Serving?

nodeData.topic: Day 13 · If You are Dishonest with Guru, Who are You Serving?
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes up arjavam, simplicity or straightforwardness, from the list of qualities a disciple cultivates to serve the guru. Through Sanatana Gosvami, Krishna at the feast and a businessman who made Krishna his director, he shows that duplicity blocks advancement, and that simplicity grows when we first ask how our actions will benefit others. Questions follow on dealing with crooked people and on pretending to be a devotee. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse lists the qualities a disciple learns in order to serve the spiritual master; today Maharaj takes up one of them, arjavam — simplicity or straightforwardness.

Arjavam is rendered both as simplicity and as straightforwardness. Maharaj asks whether these are the same, and answers: a simple person is straightforward, while a crooked person is the opposite.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:30 (auto-transcript): “Another place, it is translated as, as straightforward, straight. What would they be the same? A simple person is straightforward.”

Sridhara Svami gives clarity or transparency as a synonym. Straightforwardness does not mean being rude in the name of honesty; it means speaking the humble truth.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:39 (auto-transcript): “According to Sri Dada Swami, swachatam or clarity, transparency, is a synonym for this. Unless one is pure in consciousness, he will adopt many crooked means. Straightforwardness does not indicate that one should be audaz in the name of honesty, but that one should speak the…”

Reading from a book by HH Sivarama Swami, Maharaj stresses that simplicity is not lack of intelligence; it is required of the most learned brahmana and means the absence of shrewdness, pretence and deceit.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:03 (auto-transcript): “Simplicity should not be confused with simple mindedness. Simple mindedness. Simplicity, simple-mindedness is different. Could it be an indication of little intelligence or judgment?”

Simplicity means freedom from deceit: presenting yourself exactly as you are.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:39 (auto-transcript): “means one is free from deceit. Travort means as you tell exactly what I am. That is simplicity. Shilaprabhupad defines the Sanskrit words for simplicity as Arjavam or Amaya.”

Srila Prabhupada defines it as freedom from mental duplicity — being without diplomacy, so straightforward that one could disclose the truth even to an enemy.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:56 (auto-transcript): “Shila Prabhupada gives an example. Simplicity means that one is without diplomacy. Without diplomacy, one should be so straightforward that he can disclose the real truth even to an enemy. to an enemy.”

Sanatana Gosvami gave money to a man who meant to kill him. Maharaj notes he could have disappeared, or called the king's soldiers, since the king was searching for him — but he did neither.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:03 (auto-transcript): “Shilasanathan Goswami He gave money to a person who wanted to kill him. It's not because he is afraid of death. he can also disappear. He has the ability to do that. As a politician physically”

He gave from the heart, for the good of the man about to commit a crime. His purity changed the man's mind; he repented, begged forgiveness and returned the money, grateful to be saved from the sin. — “Sanatana Goswami's purity”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:20 (auto-transcript): “No duplicity. He did from their heart for the benefit to the person who was going to commit a crime. Sanatana Goswami's purity affected the mind. The mind repented. Begci for forgiveness. Please, take the money back. you have protected me from the sin I was going to do you…”

A teacher's example: a guru offers his disciple more prasada; the disciple wants it but keeps saying no, worried people will talk about him. Maharaj says we borrowed this habit from Krishna — so it is not our fault, it is Krishna's fault.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:25 (auto-transcript): “Guru Gavina Maharaj, he explained. He gave example. The Guru as a disciple. Taking prasada. Are you satisfied? You can take more. No, no, no, Guru. I'm okay. Take more. No, no, no. He is interested. But he is thinking.”

From Kavi Karnapura's account of Krishna's day, Radharani blesses the preparations that they become nectar. Maharaj asks that when devotees are fed here, the prasada be blessed in the same way before eating — it is our tradition.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:44 (auto-transcript): “Next time when you are feeding devotees here, you should do the same. Take all the preparations before we start eating the blessing. Let all the prasad become then you can be disemoted. Don't forget. Don't forget. That is our custom. It's our tradition. We should follow it.…”

children.topic: Krishna afraid of being called a glutton
children.note:
Sitting with the boys, Krishna ate little though he burned to eat more, fearing the elders would call him a glutton — yet he told his friends to leave nothing on the plate. For him it is a pastime; for us such duplicity is an obstacle.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:29 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna ate little. His desire to continue eating was burning. But being afraid of being called a gluten. Gluten. One who eats too much. Krishna was looking at the parents looking at the boys if I have an appetite to finish everything but they are going to call me gluten…”

If you need more, say so and take it. Don't look at the faces; be free. Simplicity has a powerful effect on our practice. — “Just be what we are.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:08 (auto-transcript): “Just be what we are. Gluten or no gluten, just eat as you can. you need more yes I need more be free don't look at the faces just be free simplicity it has a powerful effect in our practice therefore simplicity is important If we don't practice it,”

children.topic: Duplicity with the guru blocks progress
children.note:
If we do not practise simplicity in general, we will bring duplicity into our relationship with the spiritual master too, and we will not advance.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:49 (auto-transcript): “If we don't practice it, we will not make advancements. Because we will apply it to a special master. If we don't practice simplicity, we will apply duplicity to a special master also. Yes. do you remember Mahabharata do you remember who is that there is another one”

children.topic: The disciple who hid his birth
children.note:
From the Mahabharata: a disciple serving his guru was stung until he bled, yet stayed still so as not to disturb him. Seeing this, the guru knew he was no brahmana but a kshatriya, and the disciple admitted it.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:20 (auto-transcript): “do you remember Mahabharata do you remember who is that there is another one he was serving this spiritual master and inside beat him blood was coming but he remained patient and continue the service. So when the Guru saw, no, this is not the Brahman,”

Maharaj draws the lesson: duplicity has held back our progress in Krishna consciousness, so we need straightforwardness.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:26 (auto-transcript): “duplicity have impeded our progress in Christian consciousness. Therefore, there is need for straightforwardness. Yes. From an honor perspective, simplicity may be appreciated as a natural dominion, natural, you know, evidence or symptoms.”

A simple person is easily understood and trusted; a deceitful person leaves listeners doubting who he really is. There is potency in straightforwardness — it is character itself.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:33 (auto-transcript): “In speech, and Prabhupada said a fool does not understand until he speaks a deceitful person speaks too fast that you will be able to understand it very fast you meet up about the speed of understanding him I concluded Mr. N Mr. N”

Vasudeva defeated Kamsa easily through straightforwardness: Kamsa knew that whatever Vasudeva said was final and would never change.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:49 (auto-transcript): “Vasudev defeated Kamsa very easily his straightforwardness Kamsa knows whatever Vasudev said that is final He would never change it. Because Vasudev was a pradarshi, a simple, and this is a character. Krishna names simplicity as one of the nine natural qualities of a Brahmana.”

Like every quality, simplicity can be cultivated. Maharaj repeats the practice: watch the mind, check the crooked thoughts inside, and express yourself openly in word and deed.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:57 (auto-transcript): “And if a person can see his mind and see his mind, then this is a Brahmin, he is expressing the duplicitous thoughts, he is keeping within himself, that is not a Brahmin, I will repeat, checking duplicitous thoughts, checking, checking, yes, inside which which are incumbent…”

Narada lists freedom from duplicity among the qualities of a sudra too. Maharaj remarks that in Kali-yuga such qualities make the sudra's position very high.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:39 (auto-transcript): “See, the quality of a sutra is very, very high, very high, very high, Shudra doesn't tell life, but Brahmanas are telling life, Kalyuga, to be a sutra is a very, very high position. While it is understandable that in a matter of diplomacy and trade, one cannot always”

Prabhupada wants all members of the society to cultivate simplicity — so what does a devotee in business do, when business seems to require lies? Maharaj puts the question to the room.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:19 (auto-transcript): “The Prophet said here, all the members of Krishna consciousness should cultivate simplicity. So what will he do? A businessman, a business lady, and you have to tell her to make money. at the same time our master said practice simplicity so what will you do close a business…”

Closing the business is not the answer. Claiming to sell at cost price would itself be cheating; scripture permits the merchant a reasonable margin.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:00 (auto-transcript): “close a business what to do that is not the answer what is the answer don't stay nice proper said”

What is not permitted is deceit beyond that allowance — selling something as gold when it is not. That is duplicity.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:05 (auto-transcript): “But if a devotee should not tell someone this is gold, which is not gold, that is duplicity. Outside the allotted amount of life is such a hotel. A vashash hotel. That is Bhamishavad. Every devotee.”

A leading businessman in Mumbai became a devotee, cut out the unnecessary practices and dropped from first to third place. Even permitted business carries a penalty: pay dues to Krishna and make him the director. Then we are free, not implicated.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:46 (auto-transcript): “Every devotee. Mumbai. Mumbai. Few years ago. He was number one Bologna. When he became a devotee, what to do? Looking at the scriptures, he has to cut down all the unnecessary things. Then he came to number three. This is good. This is allowed.”

children.topic: Think first: will it benefit everyone?
children.note:
To cultivate simplicity, before acting ask how it will benefit others. Selfishness keeps us crooked; putting others' spiritual welfare first frees us from 'I and mine'.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:24 (auto-transcript): “that our activities will benefit others. Our activities will benefit others. If we want to cultivate simplicity this is a process that whatever I want to do it should be beneficial for everyone is it clear if one remains selfish not considering the welfare”

children.topic: Loosening the knot in the heart
children.note:
Distributing books, prasada and the holy name, speaking about Krishna, or supporting those who do — all benefit everyone. By this the knots loosen and one becomes a simple servant of Krishna and well-wisher of all. — “Before we do something, we should think”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:08 (auto-transcript): “Before we do something, we should think how it will benefit everyone. Book distribution benefits everyone. Giving Prasad and benefit order. The holy name benefit order. Speaking about Krishna, benefit order. or supporting those who are doing these activities is a benefit of…”

Simplicity is not blurting out whatever we think. Maharaj recalls Krishna's austerity of speech: speak about Krishna, truthfully, pleasantly and beneficially, without agitating others.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:40 (auto-transcript): “As some people said, tell it like it is. Say, tell the truth. But what is the truth? Rather, devotism must keep in mind Krishna's instruction on the austerity of speech. We should speak words that are always truthful.”

Three questions from the devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:11 (auto-transcript): “What is the perfect way to deal with those who are duplicitous to us? Avoid them.”

children.topic: Q1 · How to deal with duplicitous people?
children.note:
What is the right way to deal with those who are duplicitous towards us?

🎙 Maharaj at 48:11 (auto-transcript): “What is the perfect way to deal with those who are duplicitous to us? Avoid them.”

Carefully avoid them. If you can change them, do; if not, leave them and don't waste time. — “If you can't change them, just leave them.”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:49 (auto-transcript): “Avoid them. Carefully avoid them. Otherwise, If you change them, you can change them or leave them. If you can't change them, just leave them. If you can't change them, just leave them. Don't waste time.”

Like Shakuni in the Mahabharata, some cannot be changed: cheating is their satisfaction, and a day without cheating someone, even of one rupee, feels like a bad day.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:00 (auto-transcript): “In Mahabharata. Like? Shakuni. Can't change it. It takes pleasure, that is his satisfaction. There are some people that if they don't cheat somebody, they don't feel happy, this is a bad day. They consider a day to be good when they have cheat somebody, even if it is one…”

children.topic: Q2 · Pretending to be a devotee?
children.note:
We are told to act as a devotee until we become one — how can we do that without being duplicitous?

🎙 Maharaj at 51:03 (auto-transcript): “Shri Gurdin, I've heard from you, how we should, while pretending to be a devotee, so eventually we'll become a devotee. How can we practice to pretend to be a devotee without being duplicitous? Some people, they are victims of circumstances, some people.”

A story heard from Radhanath Swami: a woman in America caught stealing told the judge she stole only to feed two children after both husbands abandoned her, and was released. Some sin from circumstance and change with training; others have it in their blood.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:11 (auto-transcript): “I have permission to Radhanath Maharaj. In America, In America, one lady was stealing, and she was caught, and the judge who had the case gave her penalty to be in jail, so she requested to say something to the judge,”

A minister who could find no sadhu for his king dressed a man in tilak and beads to play one. The 'sadhu' bluntly told the king to give up sense gratification and go to Vrindavan, and was rewarded. One such pretender would think, if pretending did this much, let me become a real devotee and make others devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:58 (auto-transcript): “So there was a man. The king told the minister, Go around my kingdom. and get a sadhu to come and speak. I want to hear. She went around. Unfortunately, there is no sadhu. He cannot go and tell the king that he is so unrighteous. You have any sadhu in your kingdom.”

children.topic: The crooked one sees a business
children.note:
Another kind of man would think: ten thousand rupees for five minutes — a very good business. He will not change. Recognise such people for what they are.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:56 (auto-transcript): “but a crooked person This is a very good business. This is a very good business. Just one day? In one day, how much money? 10,000 rupees for just five minutes. In five minutes, I've got 10,000 rupees. Let me maintain this business. Now, I'll make this business. I'll become a…”

children.topic: Q3 · An honest livelihood without selling prasada?
children.note:
If selling prasada is not proper, what is a simple, honest way for young devotees to maintain themselves while preaching in town?

🎙 Maharaj at 62:02 (auto-transcript): “So, during the class and you said that a devotee can distribute prashad, books the only name, then teach but I remember also that Krishna said we cannot sell the prashad it's a sinful activity like we cannot pass tall urine blood in the water and actually when we are…”

There are many sattvic businesses one can choose. Maharaj then reads Srila Prabhupada's 1977 letter asking every temple to keep prasada ready so any guest who comes is served at once — our philosophy is to take prasada, chant Hare Krishna and be happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:20 (auto-transcript): “We should. There are so many sattvic businesses that you can do. There are many.”

nodeData.topic: Day 14 · Celibacy is to be Observed with Your Wife Too
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Continuing with the disciple's qualities, Maharaj takes up celibacy: restricting association between men and women is a basic principle for every ashrama, householders included. He explains why sense enjoyment on the bodily platform is really punishment, how our upbringing and late nights on the internet weaken our sadhana, and why, with the best philosophy and process, we still lack faith. A question closes on whether devotees should stay silent when wrong practices are endorsed. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
There are two ways: renounce sex life completely, or engage in it according to scripture as a grihastha. When there is no spiritual purpose, household life becomes grihamedhi life, which Maharaj calls very dangerous.

🎙 Maharaj at 00:11 (auto-transcript): “Other, one completely renounce it, or one is engaged according to the regulations of the scripture. In that sense, we become grihasta, grihasta, in that sense. When there is no purpose, it is grihasta life. When there is no purpose Griha Medhi”

Maharaj recalls Srila Prabhupada saying that regulated householders who work in factories or elsewhere and give what they earn to Krishna are renounced. In this way Prabhupada created sannyasa within household life.

🎙 Maharaj at 01:50 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada said in the court this regulated householders working in the factories or other places what they end they give to Krishna they are renounced they are renounced So we see how Prabhupada created”

Reading from HH Sivarama Swami's book: of the 21 qualities, celibacy — restricting association between men and women — needs special attention. Varnashrama prescribes different kinds of celibacy for each ashrama, but one underlying reason applies to all.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:09 (auto-transcript): “Shivaram Swami of the 21 qualities celibacy restricting the association between men and women is one that requires additional attention it is most important Varana ashrama dharma prescribes different kinds of celibacy I could into different ashramas”

children.topic: The duality of man and woman
children.note:
Narada explains that while one identifies with the body, one stays caught in the duality of male and female, and the bewildered intelligence is always in danger of falling.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:54 (auto-transcript): “As long as living entity is not as long as he is not independent the misconception of identifying what is body which is nothing but the reflection of the original body and senses He cannot be relieved of the conception of duality, which is victimized by the duality between…”

Maharaj draws out the principle: whenever we use anything for ourselves instead of for Krishna, we are bound. That is the foundation of sinful life and the reason we suffer.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:30 (auto-transcript): “The living entity becomes bound by your activities. When we use anything, our self instead of Krishna. That is the foundation for sinful life. And the reason why we suffer is anything used for our self instead of Krishna.”

Physical enjoyment between two conditioned souls is not enjoyment at all but punishment. In our conditioned state we take the punishment to be pleasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:23 (auto-transcript): “It is not a physical enjoyment between two conditioned souls. Physical enjoyment between two conditioned souls. It is not an enjoyment. It is punishment.”

Maharaj notes that homosexuality, transsexuality and over-indulgence are all increasing in society — whimsical, unregulated desire, which people do not recognise as punishment.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:28 (auto-transcript): “Homosexuality is increasing. Transsexuality is also increasing. Transsexuality, different species, general species, And over-indulgence is considered whimsically unregulated emotion.”

He presses the class: why is it punishment? The body is matter. Can matter enjoy matter?

🎙 Maharaj at 12:53 (auto-transcript): “Why is it punishment? This is matter. This is matter. It's enjoyment. It's enjoyment. No, I'm asking. This is what we are doing. No, it's enjoyment. So, I am asking this enjoyment. Matter, matter. Will enjoy? Will enjoy?”

children.topic: A beautiful body without a soul
children.note:
Suppose you were given a most beautiful form from heaven, but with no soul inside — would you enjoy it? No. Enjoyment belongs to the soul, not the body; physical pleasure drags the soul's activity down to the bodily platform.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:56 (auto-transcript): “A beautiful girl from heaven. the soul is not inside very handsome I will give to you enjoy you do the soul is not there to the body but very beautiful to linger”

The rules governing men and women apply to householders and sannyasis alike, because the point is the soul, not the body. Common to all forms of celibacy is what Prabhupada calls the basic principle of spiritual life: restricting association between men and women.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:32 (auto-transcript): “The rules that regulate the general conduct between men and women are set to apply equally for great actions, as pastors and janyasis. Because the whole thing is the spirit, the soul. Not the body, it is the soul.”

Brahmacaris and sannyasis must not even think of sex; grihasthas engage only at the proper time for the sake of children. Both count as celibacy.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:46 (auto-transcript): “Brahmachari and Sanyasi are forbidden to even think about it. But GRIHASTHAS, they indulge in sex during the period of favorable procreation. For the sake of progeny. Both fall in the category of celibacy.”

Prabhupada's definition covers the married man too: no relationships outside marriage, and restraint even with one's own wife at the times scripture forbids. He gave ample instruction; the challenge is whether devotees raised in a permissive society will practise it.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:34 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada describes celibacy as continence or abstaining from misuse of one's semen, not indulging in sex with women other than one's own wife and not for having sex with one's own wife when sex is forbidden, like during the period of masturbation. Srila Prabhupada to…”

Where the culture promotes sex life, it is hard to take up this practice. The background we bring into Krishna consciousness reflects heavily in our sadhana.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:12 (auto-transcript): “is a challenge in some places where the culture promotes sex life. So when taking to Krishna consciousness Would they be interested in Krishna's consciousness and keeping to this practice?”

Maharaj observes that education was once shaped by missionaries and is now controlled by scientists, whose philosophy is: don't suppress it, the more the better. Children raised this way find spiritual life feel like punishment.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:42 (auto-transcript): “In the beginning The education was not established by scientists, scientists. This is not this. scientist you started it scientist scientist”

Travelling years ago with sannyasis to Kanai Natshala, five shared a room. At 2 am Maharaj found one young devotee still awake. Later the devotee said he had marvelled that the Swamis slept like babies — in his club days he went to bed at five. Habits are easy to form and very hard to give up.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:49 (auto-transcript): “Some years ago, we were traveling with a sin of devotees and we went to this place, Kanai nat shala that time the the temple was not there the guest of night was not”

children.topic: Night on the net, japa after mangala-arati
children.note:
Many stay up at night on the internet — not preaching — then suffer through the day and start their japa only after mangala-arati.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:27 (auto-transcript): “but after mangalarati why? in the night they are not sleeping they are on the net not preaching christian consciousness they are wearing suffering in the daytime in a daytime day night on the net not prachy”

Maya is not a conditioned soul but a pure devotee of the Lord, stronger than us and expert: on the net we never notice the time passing.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:14 (auto-transcript): “sanctification so and we should remember we should always remember the personality we call Maya is not a conditioned soul pure devotee is stronger than us stronger than us so she makes it very nice”

With a consciousness already polluted by such garbage, our japa becomes artificial, like an elephant's bath. Many of us do it, and so the heart does not become pure. — “our heart is not becoming purified”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:29 (auto-transcript): “so many destructions will come and we have already polluted the consciousness deeply what all those garbages we will do job that consciousness everything is artificial our practice artificial not legal that is why our heart is not becoming purified because of our practice we…”

children.topic: What the Amish have that we lack
children.note:
When a man killed members of the Amish community, they went to his family and told them they had forgiven them. Maharaj asks: would we do that? We have the Bhagavatam, the holy name and the Deities; they do not. So what is the difference?

🎙 Maharaj at 35:47 (auto-transcript): “We asked one question yesterday There is a community called Amish Amish Right? one man killed their member, and killed himself. After some time, this community, they went to the family who killed their member.”

Devotees reply: they are fully convinced of their practice, have faith in it and practise it properly; they see each other as one family and live simple, moral lives with real human qualities.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:34 (auto-transcript): “yes they are fully convinced in their practice and they're doing it fully convinced in their practice we are not convinced of what we're doing good you'll say something about let me ask one yes they consider each of them one family good yes they believe what they're doing…”

We have a great philosophy, a powerful process and the best acaryas, but no faith; we don't practise what we have been given, so it is not working for us. Any sincere person can see this. — “we are bending towards knowledge not bhakti”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:49 (auto-transcript): “We have big philosophy. powerful process the best acharyas we have no faith we don't practice what is given to us we are bending towards knowledge not bhakti therefore Therefore, what we have is not working for us. It is very open, very clear. Every sincere person can see it.”

We should build a culture that works. Even people with a difficult background can advance in this process, despite the challenges, if all of us are really practising it.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:38 (auto-transcript): “We should cultivate a culture that works. So even persons who have this wrong condition, if we come to this process with all the challenges, we can still make advancements. If the members are falling, we still make advancements.”

HH Bhakti Tirtha Swami said he put in extra effort because he knew his background; he could not move at the same speed as others.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:51 (auto-transcript): “His Holiness, Parham Puja Bhakti Tirithi Swami Maharaj, said, he said, I am putting a stride effort because I know my background. I cannot use the same speed with you. I have to use a different speed. From there to 2004 I was in Chawpati We went together to Mayapur”

On a trip from Chowpatty to Mayapur, Maharaj stayed in the Ganga long after the others; the brahmacaris laughed at him and he laughed too. He explained that, coming from much further away, he had to stay longer to rise to their standard. — “I have to stay longer”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:34 (auto-transcript): “We went together to Mayapur So all of us, we went to Ganga The Indian devotees, the deep day, they came out I stayed there in the water for a long time So all the Brahmacharis, they left me. So when I came later, they were laughing. I was also laughing. They were laughing, I…”

One who does not know he is sick never goes to hospital. We have taken to Krishna consciousness but are not giving our best and so are not getting the result; we must see where we are and where we want to go.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:08 (auto-transcript): “So when a person doesn't know he's sick, you will not go to the hospital. Only when one is convinced and see that you go to the hospital. We have taken to Krishna consciousness we are not putting in our best efforts we are not getting all that we are supposed to get…”

A question relayed in English after it was asked in Hindi.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:33 (auto-transcript): “His grace, Lopanath Gohar Prabhuji was asking, thanking Shla Gurudev and appreciating that how Shla Gurudev touched upon these very sensitive topics today. children.note:
A grihastha thanks Maharaj for raising these sensitive topics. He was disturbed to hear of a same-sex wedding in a devotee community attended by senior devotees, and, as a father of daughters, asks whether he should just close his eyes.

nodeData.topic: Day 15 · Devotion in Public, Violence in Private?
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes up ahimsa, non-violence, and shows how much deeper it goes than not harming bodies: violence to oneself, to one's wife, to fellow devotees, and even through preaching done with a proud or doubting mind. True non-violence means helping others towards Krishna, with compassion and humility. In the questions he explains how our thoughts spread into the world and why devotees should always wish others well. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Today's quality from the verse is ahimsa, non-violence. Maharaj stresses Srila Prabhupada's point that without knowing the subtle laws of karma one cannot really practise it, and many people do not know what violence is.

Violence is not only towards others. Some harm their own bodies in anger — gross self-violence. Subtler forms are done every day: illicit sex destroys one's own body, and failing to stick to Krishna consciousness is itself violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:16 (auto-transcript): “As some people who know, do not know that violence is not only to other people. I can do, I can be violent to myself. But there are some people, very angry with themselves. They will cut it themselves.”

Eating meat is violence both to the other creature and to oneself. People think it is enjoyment because they do not know the laws of karma.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:37 (auto-transcript): “Meat eating. It's both ways. To the other entity, to the same. So it's violence. Many people don't know this. So the prophet said, unless one is a way of the subtle loss of karma. We don't know that taking a call is not an enjoyment, it is violence.”

Maharaj asked a devotee — not a demon, a devotee — whether he beat his wife. He answered with a question: who told you? Maharaj takes the defensiveness as a sign of guilt and dishonesty, which is itself violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:13 (auto-transcript): “I ask one devotee. A devotee. Not a demon. A devotee. Do you beat your wife? I ask. Do you beat your wife? anybody tell you something that was the answer he gave to me anybody tell you something what does that mean”

Pressed further, the man said he struck her without leaving a wound, so it was fine. Maharaj says the statement itself is torture — a devotee justifying himself because there is no mark.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:03 (auto-transcript): “Still defensive. Very dangerous, very dangerous. He said, I didn't want her. I didn't want her. I didn't want her. I didn't want her. But what does this mean? I'm too far. Justified. I beat her butt, no wound on the body.”

children.topic: The cry spreads, the reaction returns
children.note:
The sound of the pain goes out into the ether and spreads. The one who strikes is punished both for himself and for the one he hurt; Maharaj warns he may take a female body next life and be struck in turn.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:05 (auto-transcript): “violence to the eater listen the sound has come out it has gone to the eater and now it is spreading to the earth's planet because I feel pain Because I have been punished for this. He has been punished for himself.”

We still have not accepted how deeply wrong this is. Such violence is not what the spiritual master hopes for in his disciples. — “The spiritual master is not expecting this from disciples.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:03 (auto-transcript): “Till now we have not agreed what is deadly wrong. Violence. The spiritual master is not expecting this from disciples. That is why the Guru and the Sadhu are human, because the Guru does not keep the dream of this nature. Violence. Shriya Prabhupada. Ultimately, the material…”

Prabhupada explains that the whole material world, with old age, disease and death, is violent, and we pay for our own violence. Convincing others to surrender to Krishna and so freeing them from nature's laws is the perfection of non-violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:42 (auto-transcript): “Ultimately, the material world is full of violence and the laws of nature which imposes old age, disease and death upon Every liberal Christian are themselves filled with violence. But the nature is violence.”

The Gita's purport says it more directly: non-violence means not putting others into distress, and people suffer from ignorance. So unless we raise them to spiritual knowledge, we are violent. — “if we don't preach Krishna consciousness well, we are violent people.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:53 (auto-transcript): “It means, if we don't preach Krishna consciousness well, we are violent people. Right? Okay, let's look at it carefully. Some of us can claim, Therefore, I am not violent, are you sure, are you sure, are you sure, I am preaching every”

Someone may say: I preach every day, seminars, lectures everywhere — so I am not violent. Look carefully: if in my mind I see you as fools to be delivered, that mood transfers to you, cripples your self-esteem and you never become devotees. In kirtan, thinking 'I am the centre' is false ego — violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:17 (auto-transcript): “Some of us can claim, Therefore, I am not violent, are you sure, are you sure, are you sure, I am preaching every Every day. Every day. Every day. Regular seminars. Lectures. Everywhere.”

What we carry inside is what we actually give, not the words we send out. — “Preaching means compassion.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:17 (auto-transcript): “Preaching means compassion. Some years ago, In Pune, one day I was passing through the school, and the headmaster, she asked me, Mahalad, please bless me, I said, okay, my blessing is, don't teach these people for money,”

In Pune a headmistress asked Maharaj's blessing. He told her: take the salary, but don't teach for it. Teach for money and the children will surely be exploited; teach because you love them and want them better, and that energy reaches every student.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:26 (auto-transcript): “Some years ago, In Pune, one day I was passing through the school, and the headmaster, she asked me, Mahalad, please bless me, I said, okay, my blessing is, don't teach these people for money,”

children.topic: Cooking and kirtan carry our mind
children.note:
Whether cooking, leading kirtan or speaking, if our motive is money or lust, that is what we distribute. Prabhupada changed how we look at people: instead of 'what can I get?', a devotee thinks how to save this person by giving Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:12 (auto-transcript): “In the same way, we are cooking, we are knitting kiritani, we are speaking, but we are speaking or money or lust that is what we are distributing is it clear so we are we should distribute books”

children.topic: They sense what we don't believe
children.note:
If our own faith is weak, the listener perceives it: you don't believe what you are telling me, yet you want me to be like you? We must check what we give out, preach because we care, and admit how little we have realised.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:16 (auto-transcript): “We are talking to someone. But we don't believe what we are talking about. Our faith is not strong. So they are a person or people who are talking to. They will perceive it. They will look at you. You don't believe what you are telling me. You want me to be like you? Yeah, I do.”

From HH Sivarama Swami's book: non-violence is widely honoured, as in Gandhi, but pacifists mean not harming another's body, while the Vaishnava means conduct that does not obstruct the spiritual growth of any living being.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:24 (auto-transcript): “Say it. Non-violence has long been associated with and identified as one of the qualities of a spirituality. Gandhi's self-affiliation with non-binary lead him to be considered a sadhu, a saint among politicians.”

Maharaj saw a devotee carefully step around an ant on the ground, yet he abused his own godbrothers — honestly, he hated them. People trying to chant and become devotees are not spared, while the ant is. Non-violence is deeper than that.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:14 (auto-transcript): “I saw one devotee who was passing and he was avoiding the ant on the ground. But he was using great fellow devotees. What is that? The ant, oh yeah, notice her. Living entities. His fellow, God brother, God sees you who have practiced in descent, he doesn't create it.”

Saying things that disturb devotees' minds, not being happy to see a devotee, not greeting devotees as if they do not exist, vulgar language — Maharaj names each one as violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:17 (auto-transcript): “Violence. to say something could disturb the minds of devotees what is that? violence not feeling happy to see a devotee is what?”

Where everyone carries a weapon, some say it is for protection, and they are partly right — even a peaceful Swami once had to in a violent place. But few carry for defence; mostly it is a violent culture, where someone can openly say he is happy when he kills.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:29 (auto-transcript): “And a society. Everyone carried down. What is that? Protection from volume. Not protection. Of course, they are partially correct. Because his soul in the Bhaktita Maharaj, he said,”

Each living being has a set duration in a body. Killing even an ant interferes with nature: the soul must wait for its next body before its time. Abortion is the same violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:47 (auto-transcript): “all living entities have a duration to exist in a particular body so if you kill an ant it is violence because you have been interfaced with nature this soul how to wait for the next body because it is not that time so how will the soul wait the same thing, abortion”

Many doctors, and even some religious groups, hold that the soul is not in the body until seven months, so the child can be removed. Maharaj calls this violence.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:48 (auto-transcript): “And so there are many doctors who are violent. Because their philosophy is there is no soul in the body until seven months. So it is not human being yet. So I can remove it. Violence. Not only doctors, many people agree this is true.”

At an interfaith dialogue a woman challenged the Hare Krishna speaker with that view. Maharaj asked: if the soul is not there, what makes the body develop? Chemicals? Then why would a soul ever need to enter? When the soul leaves, the body stops. — “it is the presence in the soul that is making the body to grow”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:29 (auto-transcript): “The first person who challenged me was a woman. I was shocked to hear this from the Hare Krishna man. The soul is not there in the body. Until the seven months. I said, the soul is not in the body. What is making the body to develop?”

He saw an advertisement on a train offering abortion in just two hours. We commit violence if we cannot train and convince people to give up this practice — and we cannot, while we ourselves do not believe what we do. So correct our consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:53 (auto-transcript): “I have seen in the train When I saw the train, I posted a little less abortion for only two hours. A little less abortion, only? Means what? Just two hours. And it is less. because it's violence. Therefore,”

Questions on preaching without pride and on how our thoughts affect others, and a personal sharing from Maharaj.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:42 (auto-transcript): “You said one example you gave about violence. When we are preaching and in our mind we are thinking that another person is a fool. You are telling we are reducing other self-esteem. Can you explain with more? I don't understand with more. It is useless, Spiro.”

children.topic: Q1 · How does preaching lower self-esteem?
children.note:
If in our mind we think the other person is a fool while preaching, how does that reduce their self-esteem?

🎙 Maharaj at 52:42 (auto-transcript): “You said one example you gave about violence. When we are preaching and in our mind we are thinking that another person is a fool. You are telling we are reducing other self-esteem. Can you explain with more? I don't understand with more. It is useless, Spiro.”

Prabhupada saw everyone as Krishna's parts suffering without Krishna. His prayer was: I am unqualified, I have no power to reach these people — you brought me here, so make me dance as you like. No ego, only compassion; that is the mood of all our acaryas, and it is what penetrates.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:29 (auto-transcript): “What was Prabhupada's mood? What was Prabhupada's mood? What was Prabhupada's mood? Krishna, if he wants me to make me happy, is that arrogance or compassion? Humility. Is that humility?”

children.topic: Q2 · How do our thoughts spread?
children.note:
Maharaj said that whatever we do, positive or negative, spreads through the universe; a saintly person said the same. How does that work?

🎙 Maharaj at 57:51 (auto-transcript): “You mentioned that principle that when you do something positive, it goes all over the Brahman. I remember there was a saintly person, Krishna Mahal Swami from South India, we met at the railway station. He also used to often tell in his teachings the same thing. I never…”

Some people are never happy whatever you do; their minds are polluted. What we think is a message sent into the ether, unseen; sound can heal or even kill. And what we send out comes back to us, as the cook eats his own dish.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:57 (auto-transcript): “Their mind is extremely polluted. Because what we are thinking is a message. It's a person. We may not see it grossly. But it's a person. So, we are sending that to the ETA. Now, through sound, we can communicate like sound. And with sound, we can kill someone with sound.”

That is why we are told to think of Krishna: it changes our thoughts and heals the world. Otherwise I am adding to the violence going on everywhere.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:57 (auto-transcript): “That's why we have been warned that we are going to think about Krishna. And this is the way we are going to change our thoughts inside. When we think about Krishna, we are healing this whole Brahman. The healing, the eater, the population, they say half of the population,…”

Praying for others works on the same principle: what we send out returns. The theme of the class is to be a well-wisher of everyone from the heart. — “that we should always wish well for others”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:46 (auto-transcript): “So when we are praying for someone, this is in the same way right this is the same principle so she will always pray pray for the well being of others of the well being of others so it comes back to us also yes what we are sending out it will come back so this should be our…”

A devotee recalls Maharaj quoting scripture that the fruit of a fast or austerity can be offered for someone else.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:07 (auto-transcript): “I was listening to... Shri Gurdjieh is telling that I was listening to these things. He quoted a scripture, I forgot exactly. I will listen to the lecture again. He quoted the scripture. When you fast, it takes some while. Some austerity. I offer the result to someone. You…”

When Maharaj hears something, he does it. He dedicated a Navadvipa parikrama to Mahavishnu Swami in hospital, and days of fasting at a Govardhan retreat to Jayapataka Swami, offering it in his mind to the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:03 (auto-transcript): “When I hear something, I do it. During the Navadi Pandal Parikrama, I dedicated that to Maha Vishnu Swami when he was in the hospital. I was doing a bliss retreat in Gowaldhan. I think four days, four days, I was not eating. It was a dedication to Resolver Japataka Swam.”

That morning a devotee asked why Maharaj is the same every day. His answer: two things — what he eats and the state of his mind.
